claims.quote: OKF is a format, not a service or a platform. OKF v0.1 represents knowledge as a directory of markdown files with YAML frontmatter. A small set of agreed-upon conventions lets wikis written by one producer be consumed by a different agent without translation.

claims.subject: Google Cloud

claims.subject: Anthropic 的 Mythos AI 是什么？为何被限制
claims.quote: Anthropic PBC has said its new artificial intelligence tool, Mythos, is so good at finding vulnerabilities in software and computer systems that it can’t be released to the general public. The AI giant released Mythos to only 200 partner organizations because if a tool this powerful fell into the wrong hands, Anthropic says, it could help attackers more easily steal data or disrupt critical infrastructure.

claims.subject: Anthropic 的 Mythos AI 是什么？为何被限制
claims.quote: Despite the precautions taken by Anthropic, the Trump administration on June 12 ordered the company to keep its most advanced models out of the hands of all foreign nationals inside and outside the US. Anthropic said it believes the US government issued the order after discovering that it’s possible to “jailbreak,” or bypass the guardrails, of Fable 5.

claims.quote: However, greater autonomy introduces security risks if agents take unintended actions. This is especially true for local agents, which often run near files, credentials, environment variables, MCP tools, and have access to production systems.

events.subject: Google AI
events.action: 发布 DiffusionGemma：基于文本扩散的 26B MoE 开源模型
events.object: ，生成速度最高提升 4 倍

claims.subject: Google AI
claims.object: ，生成速度最高提升 4 倍
claims.quote: Google AI team including the Google DeepMind researchers have just released DiffusionGemma, an experimental open model for text generation. It uses text diffusion instead of standard autoregressive decoding. The model ships under a permissive Apache 2.0 license. Google positions it for devs and researchers exploring speed-critical, interactive local workflows. Examples include in-line editing, rapid iteration, and generating non-linear text structures.

claims.subject: Google AI
claims.object: ，生成速度最高提升 4 倍
claims.quote: Most language models in use today are autoregressive. They generate one token at a time, left to right. Each new token depends on the token before it. DiffusionGemma works differently. It generates entire blocks of text simultaneously, in parallel. On dedicated GPUs, this delivers up to 4x faster generation.

claims.subject: Google AI
claims.object: ，生成速度最高提升 4 倍
claims.quote: What is DiffusionGemma

claims.subject: Google AI
claims.object: ，生成速度最高提升 4 倍
claims.quote: DiffusionGemma is a 26B Mixture of Experts (MoE) model. It activates only 3.8B parameters during inference. It is built on the Gemma 4 backbone, specifically the 26B-A4B architecture. Google integrated a diffusion head onto that base.

events.sourceExcerpt: Google AI team including the Google DeepMind researchers have just released DiffusionGemma, an experimental open model for text generation. It uses text diffusion instead of standard autoregressive decoding. The model ships under a permissive Apache 2.0 license. Google positions it for devs and researchers exploring speed-critical, interactive local workflows. Examples include in-line editing, rapid iteration, and generating non-linear text structures.

events.title: Google DeepMind 发布 DiffusionGemma，本地 AI 推理速度提升 4 倍
events.subject: Google DeepMind
events.object: DiffusionGemma，本地 AI 推理速度提升 4 倍

claims.subject: Google DeepMind
claims.object: DiffusionGemma，本地 AI 推理速度提升 4 倍
claims.quote: Another day, another AI model from Google. This time, Google DeepMind has released a new member of the Gemma 4 open model family , but it’s fundamentally different from the rest of the lineup. DiffusionGemma doesn’t generate outputs linearly like most AI models. Instead, it can produce an entire block of text in parallel. Google says this makes it faster and more efficient when running on local hardware like an Nvidia DGX or a humble gaming GPU.

claims.subject: Google DeepMind
claims.object: DiffusionGemma，本地 AI 推理速度提升 4 倍
claims.quote: Most AI models are designed to be autoregressive—they generate text left to right one token at a time. DiffusionGemma has more in common with image generation models, which start with static and then denoise it to create the desired content. This model takes a field of placeholder tokens running over the canvas multiple times to generate likely tokens and using those to improve estimation of others. At the end of the process, the model finalizes its token outputs in one large block—the “denoised” text canvas.

claims.subject: Google DeepMind
claims.object: DiffusionGemma，本地 AI 推理速度提升 4 倍
claims.quote: DiffusionGemma is fairly large in the realm of Google’s open models. It’s a Mixture of Experts (MoE) model with a total of 26 billion parameters, but only 3.8 billion are activated during inference. That means it should fit in the 18GB RAM allotment of a high-end GPU. In testing with an RTX 5090, DiffusionGemma spits out around 700 tokens per second. With a single Nvidia H100 AI accelerator, DiffusionGemma can produce 1,000+ tokens per second. That’s about four times the output of the similarly sized autoregressive Gemma models.

claims.subject: Google DeepMind
claims.object: DiffusionGemma，本地 AI 推理速度提升 4 倍
claims.quote: This approach to text generation shifts the bottleneck from memory bandwidth to compute, generating up to 256 tokens in parallel. Google says this offers a measurable boost in non-linear tasks like in-line editing, molecular sequencing, and mathematical graphing. The animation above shows how DiffusionGemma was tuned to solve Sudoku puzzles, which is a notoriously challenging task for standard autoregressive AI models because each token depends on future tokens. DiffusionGemma’s ability to continuously self-correct large sets of tokens makes that easier.

events.sourceExcerpt: Another day, another AI model from Google. This time, Google DeepMind has released a new member of the Gemma 4 open model family , but it’s fundamentally different from the rest of the lineup. DiffusionGemma doesn’t generate outputs linearly like most AI models. Instead, it can produce an entire block of text in parallel. Google says this makes it faster and more efficient when running on local hardware like an Nvidia DGX or a humble gaming GPU.

claims.subject: Claude Fable
claims.object: ：Anthropic 带来的另一种推理体验
claims.quote: I had early access to the first Mythos-class AI model being released to the public, Claude 5 Fable. Much of the discussion of Mythos has centered on its impact on software security, but I tested it on everything except that (the guardrails around Fable essentially prevent it from being used for cybersecurity at all). My conclusion is that it represents a very real leap over every model I have used before, and, maybe more important, suggests our relationship with AI is changing in drastic ways.

claims.subject: Claude Fable
claims.object: ：Anthropic 带来的另一种推理体验
claims.quote: It is worth a second looking at the transcript of the multiple hour building session the AI went through on its own, because you can see some unusual things. First, the AI launched multiple other AIs (I believe mostly the cheaper Claude Sonnet) to help it conduct research on travel times, ultimately retrieving over 2,200 specific flights, the rail schedules for trains from the TGV to the Shinkansen, and road speeds per country from multiple academic papers. And while those agents were running, it started coding. Then it launched yet more agents and tests to verify its code, all the while taking notes about its progress.

claims.subject: Claude Fable
claims.object: ：Anthropic 带来的另一种推理体验
claims.quote: The result was a fully functioning map of impressive sophistication that looked a lot like the 1881 original, but that doesn’t mean it was perfect. I noticed that a lot of remote locations (like Greenland) just contained estimates of travel time, not exact numbers, so I told Fable to fix it, including the instructions: actually get travel times to remote airports and locations. This time the AI launched a workflow, adversarial groups of agents that did research and tested each others results. It figured out how often ships sail to Pitcairn Island in the Pacific and how to get to Grise Fjord from Ottawa. events.title: Apple 在 WWDC 发布升级版 AI 驱动的 Siri
events.subject: Apple 在 WWDC
events.object: 升级版 AI 驱动的 Siri

claims.subject: Apple 在 WWDC
claims.object: 升级版 AI 驱动的 Siri
claims.quote: For the past two years, Apple has been racing to catch up in AI while frustrations with its core software quietly added up: a design overhaul users hated, a search function that barely worked, a file-sharing feature that routinely failed, and a Health app that didn’t focus enough on half its user base. Apple didn’t say any of that on Monday. But the structure of its WWDC keynote said it for them, leading with fixes before features, and framing a better Siri as one item on a long list of improvements rather than the main event. At minimum, the sequencing suggests Apple believes the foundation needs shoring up before it can credibly ask users to trust it with something as consequential as AI.

claims.subject: Apple 在 WWDC
claims.object: 升级版 AI 驱动的 Siri
claims.quote: In a subtle acknowledgment that people are holding onto their phones longer these days, Apple said it extended performance improvements to all models back to iPhone 11, a phone released in 2019.

claims.subject: Apple 在 WWDC
claims.object: 升级版 AI 驱动的 Siri
claims.quote: Apple’s Health app — which had gone years without meaningfully supporting half its user base — added support for perimenopause and menopause tracking. It’s a long-overdue move that arrives as the menopause care market hits its stride: Earlier this year, menopause telehealth startup Midi Health crossed a $1 billion valuation, and dedicated investment in the category topped $294 million between 2022 and last year.

claims.object: 内容
claims.quote: Apple’s WWDC 2026 event kicked off this morning at 10 a.m. PT at Apple Park, starting a week full of expected announcements around Siri , iOS 27, Apple Intelligence and more, along with developer events and demos. This year’s event is particularly notable for a couple things. It marks CEO Tim Cook’s last with the company, after announcing he’s handing things off to Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering John Ternus September 1 . And it’s expected to play host to Apple’s attempt to give Siri and its AI efforts overall a big boost after handing some work off to Google and delaying some releases .

claims.subject: WWDC 2026：Siri、iOS 27、Apple Intelligence 等全部
claims.object: 内容
claims.quote: Claiming that its upcoming update will be “available to more users than any iOS release ever,” Apple revealed that all devices from the iPhone 11 onward will be eligible for their upcoming software update. And that update comes with a flurry of performance improvements it’s touting across a number of its OS releases this year, with Apple claiming that new photos will appear 70 percent more swiftly, AirDrop transfers will be 80 percent faster and CPU schedulers will be improved to help multitasking.

claims.subject: WWDC 2026：Siri、iOS 27、Apple Intelligence 等全部
claims.object: 内容
claims.quote: To take on popular AI photo editing apps, Apple is bringing new AI features to its Photos app . A new spatial “Reframe” feature will let users use AI to adjust the perspective of an image as if they had repositioned the camera in the original scene. The new “Extend” tool expands images adjust the aspect ratio of an image or add more to a scene. The app’s popular “Cleanup” tool is also getting an upgrade so users can remove distractions with better quality and more realistic infill with generative AI.

claims.subject: WWDC 2026：Siri、iOS 27、Apple Intelligence 等全部
claims.object: 内容
claims.quote: “Over the years, you have helped people connect, create, learn, and experience the world in extraordinary new ways, and with the incredible capabilities we introduce today, and so many more still to come, I truly believe the best is still ahead at Apple, Cook said. “Getting the best products in the world to deliver experiences that enrich people’s lives has always been our North Star. It’s been the honor of a lifetime to help advance that mission with teams whose creativity, care, and conviction continue to make a lasting difference in people’s lives.”

events.object: Models on NVIDIA Blackwell | NVIDIA Blog

claims.subject: Leading Inference Providers Achieve Lowest Token Cost With
claims.object: Models on NVIDIA Blackwell | NVIDIA Blog
claims.quote: These providers host advanced open source models, which have now reached frontier-level intelligence. By combining open source frontier intelligence, the extreme hardware-software codesign of NVIDIA Blackwell and their own optimized inference stacks, these providers are enabling dramatic token cost reductions for businesses across every industry.

claims.subject: Leading Inference Providers Achieve Lowest Token Cost With
claims.object: Models on NVIDIA Blackwell | NVIDIA Blog
claims.quote: How Did Healthcare Platform Sully.ai Cut Inference Costs by 10x With Baseten, Open Source Models and Blackwell?

claims.subject: Leading Inference Providers Achieve Lowest Token Cost With
claims.object: Models on NVIDIA Blackwell | NVIDIA Blog
claims.quote: To overcome these bottlenecks, Sully.ai uses Baseten’s Model API , which deploys open source models such as gpt-oss-120b on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. Baseten used the low-precision NVFP4 data format, the NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM library — an open source C++/Python framework for optimizing large language model inference on NVIDIA GPUs that includes tensor parallelism, batching and in-flight attention optimizations — and the NVIDIA Dynamo inference framework to deliver optimized inference. The company chose NVIDIA Blackwell to run its Model API after seeing up to 2.5x better throughput per dollar compared with the NVIDIA Hopper platform.

claims.subject: Leading Inference Providers Achieve Lowest Token Cost With
claims.object: Models on NVIDIA Blackwell | NVIDIA Blog
claims.quote: Latitude runs large open source models on DeepInfra’s inference platform, powered by NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and TensorRT-LLM . For a large-scale mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, DeepInfra reduced the cost per million tokens from 20 cents on the NVIDIA Hopper platform to 10 cents on Blackwell. Moving to Blackwell’s native NVFP4 format, an ultralow precision floating-point data format reducing memory bandwidth and model size while maintaining inference accuracy, further cut that cost to just 5 cents — for a total 4x improvement in cost per token — while maintaining the accuracy that customers expect.

events.sourceExcerpt: These providers host advanced open source models, which have now reached frontier-level intelligence. claims.subject: NVIDIA AI
claims.object: Nemotron 3 Ultra：开源 550B MoE 混合 Mamba-Transformer，面向长时间运行智能体
claims.quote: NVIDIA has released Nemotron 3 Ultra , the largest model in its Nemotron 3 family. It targets a specific problem: long-running agents that plan, call tools, and reason across many turns. As agents run longer, token counts grow and inference cost climbs. Nemotron 3 Ultra is designed to keep accuracy high while making that inference faster and cheaper.

claims.subject: NVIDIA AI
claims.object: Nemotron 3 Ultra：开源 550B MoE 混合 Mamba-Transformer，面向长时间运行智能体
claims.quote: NVIDIA team also released new domain-specific pretraining datasets. These include 173 billion refreshed GitHub code tokens. In a Nemotron 3 Nano ablation, a synthetic legal set raised a proxy LegalBench average from 64.6 to 74.7. In a similar ablation, a Wiki-based fact-seeking set raised proxy SimpleQA from 40.2 to 50.2.

claims.subject: NVIDIA AI
claims.object: Nemotron 3 Ultra：开源 550B MoE 混合 Mamba-Transformer，面向长时间运行智能体
claims.quote: The post-training release is also large. NVIDIA adds 10 million new SFT samples and 1 million new RL tasks. It adds 15 new RL environments. Cumulative Nemotron open totals reach 50M SFT samples, 2M RL tasks, and 55 RL environments.

claims.subject: NVIDIA AI
claims.object: Nemotron 3 Ultra：开源 550B MoE 混合 Mamba-Transformer，面向长时间运行智能体
claims.quote: The final solution operates at 5.03 bits-per-element. It mixes NVFP4 routed experts with FP8 layers for shared experts and Mamba linears. Attention layers stay in BF16. NVIDIA team found accuracy saturated below this budget, so higher precision added no measurable gain.

claims.subject: Neysa & Pipeshift
claims.object: Real-Time AI Inference
claims.quote: Against this backdrop, Neysa , a purpose-built AI Compute and Acceleration cloud provider, and Pipeshift , a managed inference platform for open-source AI models, today announced a partnership to launch production-grade real-time inference infrastructure fully deployed within India.

claims.subject: Neysa & Pipeshift
claims.object: Real-Time AI Inference
claims.quote: The partnership addresses this gap by extending Velocis, Neysa’s AI Acceleration Cloud System, with dedicated, low-latency real-time inference for enterprises deploying production AI applications. Pipeshift’s inference platform running on Neysa’s AI-native GPU infrastructure, enables enterprises to deploy single-tenant inference environments for open-source models including Gemma, Qwen, GPT-OSS, Llama, DeepSeek, and Mistral through OpenAI-compatible APIs, without managing underlying GPU infrastructure themselves.

claims.subject: Neysa & Pipeshift
claims.object: Real-Time AI Inference
claims.quote: Commenting on the announcement, Karan Kirpalani , Chief Product Officer, Neysa , said, “Scaling open-source models introduces a dual bottleneck: volatile token economics and high Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) driven by shared rate limits and cross-region routing. By integrating Pipeshift’s inference-engine optimizations directly onto Neysa’s single-tenant, optimized bare metal, we eliminate this friction entirely. The upshot for enterprises is a seamless, OpenAI-compatible drop-in replacement that guarantees cold-starts, predictable and highly optimized token latency, and absolute sovereign data control at scale.”

events.sourceExcerpt: Neysa and Pipeshift launch real-time inference for open-source AI models, fully deployed within India

The new AI Agent Marketplace, integrated directly into Google Cloud Marketplace, lets enterprise teams discover, evaluate, and deploy third-party agents built on the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol using Gemini-powered natural language search. It is the first major cloud marketplace where the discovery layer itself is agentic.

claims.subject: Google's A2A Agent Marketplace

events.subject: The AI
events.object: smackdown isn’t over

claims.subject: The AI
claims.object: smackdown isn’t over
claims.quote: The AI regulation smackdown isn’t over

claims.subject: The AI
claims.object: smackdown isn’t over
claims.quote: At the start of this week, the who’s-who of AI seemed — at least tentatively — on the side of AI regulation. Over the weekend, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei had proposed a three-step plan for slowing AI development, including by embedding third-party evaluators in labs, coordinating across the domestic industry, and forging international agreements potentially with government assistance. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Google DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis, and even SpaceX CEO Elon Musk publicly seemed to agree on aspects of all three things.

claims.subject: The AI
claims.object: smackdown isn’t over
claims.quote: Anthropic and OpenAI had already been dropping hints that they and other labs were working on some kind of industry framework. Appearing pro-regulation looked like both a good PR move and, potentially, a way for companies to address fallout from progressively more concerning hacking incidents.

claims.subject: The AI
claims.object: smackdown isn’t over
claims.quote: For now, any government involvement in this process looks like a non-starter. The Trump administration has attacked the idea of a safety crisis in AI, calling it a “hoax.” The AI world itself is also divided. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg quickly came out against limiting companies’ autonomy, and earlier this week, the Wall Street Journal reported that Zuckerberg, Musk, and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang scuttled proposals for an industry-funded independent regulator for the AI industry — akin to the ​Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), a private nonprofit regulator in finance. But parts of the industry aren’t giving up on the idea, including OpenAI.

events.sourceExcerpt: The AI regulation smackdown isn’t over

claims.object: In the MLPerf Inference v6.1 Edge Agentic benchmark, NVIDIA TensorRT Edge-LLM ran Qwen3.6-27B on a single NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor Developer Kit. The system achieved 52.33 tokens per second and completed all 1,007 turns of the performance workload in 24 minutes and 36 seconds, 6.4x faster than the llama.cpp reference submission of 2 hours and 37 minutes. The result uses NVFP4 quantization, tree-based multi-token prediction (MTP), and KV cache reuse.

claims.subject: Anthropic 15 亿美元 AI 版权
claims.object: 金开始发放，出版社与作者分配争议不断
claims.quote: 法院裁定，Anthropic 使用受版权保护的材料训练 AI 模型符合“合理使用”（Fair Use）原则，属于合法行为，但通过盗版方式获取这些材料则不受合理使用保护，因此 Anthropic 将为训练模型时使用的近 50 万部盗版作品原作者提供赔偿，补偿标准为每部盗版作品 3,000 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20,203 元人民币） ，和解金合计为 15 亿美元 （现汇率约合 101.02 亿元人民币） ，该和解方案今年 7 月获得最终批准，相关赔偿金随后开始进入发放流程。

claims.subject: Anthropic 15 亿美元 AI 版权
claims.object: 金开始发放，出版社与作者分配争议不断
claims.quote: 根据和解协议，如果相关图书仍由传统出版社出版，赔偿金将由作者和出版社各分 50%；如果图书由作者自行出版，或者出版社此前已经让该图书绝版并将版权返还给作者，那么 3,000 美元 （现汇率约合 20,203 元人民币） 赔偿金应全部归作者所有。

claims.subject: Anthropic 15 亿美元 AI 版权
claims.object: 金开始发放，出版社与作者分配争议不断
claims.quote: 对此，知名作家维权博客 Writers Beware 的作者 Victoria Strauss 表示，近期收到的作者投诉大致可以分为两类：第一类是出版社针对已经不再拥有合法版权的作品提出赔偿申领（例如版权早已返还作者的图书）；第二类则是出版社悄悄向 Anthropic 申领了 100% 的赔偿金，但按照和解协议，出版社实际上只能获得 50%。

claims.object: ：智能体"缰绳"（harness）比 AI 模型本身更关键，Claude Opus 5 在 ARC-AGI-3 上达 100% 满分
claims.quote: Nvidia published some interesting new research on Friday suggesting it’s the harness, more than the underlying model, that is far more important when asking an AI to do long-horizon tasks. A harness is the software wrapper around an AI model — the tools, memory management, and rules that turn a raw model into something that can act on its own.

claims.subject: Nvidia
claims.object: ：智能体"缰绳"（harness）比 AI 模型本身更关键，Claude Opus 5 在 ARC-AGI-3 上达 100% 满分
claims.quote: The TL;DR: Simply by using a custom harness tweaked to handle memory well and including a “supervisor” boss-like component, researchers got Claude Opus 5 to achieve a 100% score on the interactive reasoning benchmark ARC-AGI-3 — a set of 2D games with no instructions, where the model has to figure out how to play and win, similar to how a human would. (That’s a benchmark that has particularly irked rival frontier lab OpenAI.) Without the harness, Opus 5 scored 30%, which was the top result among all the models tested.

events.sourceExcerpt: Still, Nvidia’s results add to the growing evidence that model choice is far from the only factor in agentic performance. In July, for instance, Databricks published some stunning research that shows that the harness, more than the model, dramatically impacts AI costs.

claims.subject: Databricks
claims.object: Today, we are releasing OfficeQA Pro V2 , a new benchmark designed to evaluate whether AI agents can generalize to unfamiliar, enterprise-style grounded-reasoning tasks.
claims.quote: Today, we are releasing OfficeQA Pro V2 , a new benchmark designed to evaluate whether AI agents can generalize to unfamiliar, enterprise-style grounded-reasoning tasks.

claims.subject: Databricks
claims.object: Our new benchmark, OfficeQA Pro V2, is designed to test that generalization directly. We initially developed OfficeQA Pro V2 as the benchmark for the inaugural Databricks Grounded Reasoning Cup , a live competition in which 11 academic teams, supported by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind, built agents that were evaluated on a previously unseen corpus and set of grounded-reasoning tasks. The benchmark contains 90 questions grounded in approximately 120,000 pages from the U.S. Treasury’s Accounts of Receipts and Expenditures, which was released as a cohesive dataset by the U.S. Treasury for the first time in conjunction with the 250th anniversary of the United States. Now, we are excited to release the benchmark to AI practitioners more broadly to use for their own development.

Now, we are excited…

claims.subject: Databricks
claims.object: Seven months ago, we introduced the OfficeQA benchmark to measure how well AI systems answer analytical questions using evidence from large document collections, an extremely common and important enterprise task that we found agents struggled with. Since its introduction, OfficeQA, and its frontier subset, OfficeQA Pro , has become an important measure for frontier model and agent capabilities, driving progress in document retrieval, parsing, and analytical reasoning. But this progress raises a fundamental question: do these improvements reflect broader advances in grounded reasoning, or progress specific to one corpus and task distribution?

claims.subject: MirrorCode：AI 能独立完成的最大规模软件项目
claims.object: AI has made rapid progress on software engineering benchmarks in the past few years. However, most such benchmarks tend to focus on shorter tasks like fixing bugs or implementing individual features. MirrorCode is our benchmark, co-developed with METR, to test AI models on long-horizon coding tasks. In a MirrorCode task, AI models are tasked with reimplementing an entire program end-to-end, without access to the original source code. AI-generated solutions must match the original program’s output exactly on end-to-end tests, including held-out tests. MirrorCode’s 25 target programs span different areas of computing: Unix utilities, data serialization and query tools, bioinformatics, interpreters, static analysis, cryptography, and compression.

claims.object: One important caveat to these results is data contamination. Because MirrorCode tasks involve reimplementing open-source programs, AI models are likely to have seen the original codebases in pretraining. This might lead to inflated performance on the benchmark. However, AI successfully reimplemented several target programs that passed our memorization screen, and failed to reimplement programs where the screen showed evidence of memorization. This suggests that the results were not dominated by memorization, but we cannot rule out the possibility that memorization contributes to AI performance. Overall, we expect that the capabilities measured by MirrorCode would generalize to an unseen codebase. We discuss this further, along with more results and details on benchmark construction, in the paper .

claims.subject: Reddit 对 SerpApi 的 DMCA
claims.object: 获法官支持，未因 Google 败诉而撤销
claims.quote: Engelmayer’s decision came less than two weeks after another court dismissed a similar action raised by Google , finding that the company had not proven that rights holders, such as Reddit, had ever authorized the search engine to prevent the scraping of protected content. Google told Ars that it planned to amend its complaint to keep its lawsuit alive, but SerpApi told Ars that Google and Reddit were both trying to “use the DMCA to wall off the open Internet by retroactively claiming control over content that they didn’t author and don’t own.”

claims.subject: Reddit 对 SerpApi 的 DMCA
claims.object: 获法官支持，未因 Google 败诉而撤销
claims.quote: Last week, a DMCA expert with Public Knowledge, Meredith Rose, told Ars that Google and Reddit seemed to be “sort of grasping at whatever tool is available” in the face of the sudden, continuous rise of AI scraping over the past three years. And Reddit in particular appeared weirdly positioned in its DMCA claim because “the judge in the Google case said, ‘Well, in order to have standing to bring a lawsuit under the DMCA, you can be the copyright owner or the exclusive licensee or the person who is deploying and manufacturing the technological protection measure at issue,’” Rose told Ars.

claims.subject: Reddit 对 SerpApi 的 DMCA
claims.object: 获法官支持，未因 Google 败诉而撤销
claims.quote: On Friday, a judge largely denied a motion to dismiss from a web scraper, SerpApi, which is accused of conspiring with Perplexity AI to illegally scrape copyrighted Reddit content from Google search results.

claims.subject: Reddit 对 SerpApi 的 DMCA
claims.object: 获法官支持，未因 Google 败诉而撤销
claims.quote: In his opinion , US District Judge Paul A. Engelmayer said that at this early stage, Reddit has plausibly pleaded that there was a conspiracy, with SerpApi providing a product to circumvent Google access controls and Perplexity AI paying for it.

Google told Ars that it planned to amend its complaint to keep its lawsuit alive, but SerpApi told Ars that Google and Reddit were both trying to “use the DMCA to wall off the open Internet by retroactively claiming control over content that they didn’t author and don’t own.”

claims.quote: Curiously invoking the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA), Google sued SerpApi last December. claims.subject: Google 输掉

claims.quote: It was an odd use of the DMCA, since Google search results can’t be copyrighted. But Google was apparently emboldened to explore the legal theory after Reddit filed a very similar lawsuit in October, accusing SerpApi and Google-rival Perplexity of scraping Reddit content that appears in Google results.

claims.subject: Google 输掉

claims.subject: Google 输掉

claims.quote: But Google’s and Reddit’s unusual DMCA arguments don’t seem to be winning ones. In that case, the judge found that Google had no DMCA standing to sue SerpApi, since it didn’t own any of the content in the search results and has not shown that it’s acting on behalf of any rights holders.

claims.quote: Monday.com, the Tel Aviv-based work management software company known for its colorful, customizable project-tracking boards, this week became the latest tech company to cite AI as a factor in job cuts. On Wednesday, the company said in an SEC filing that it will lay off about 20% of its workforce, or just over 600 employees, as part of a “restructuring plan” tied to its “ongoing transformation of its product, marketing, and go-to-market strategy” in support of “a leaner, more focused operating model” as it continues investing in its “AI-driven growth strategy.”

claims.subject: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for
claims.object: — here are 20 others
claims.quote: Co-founder Eran Zinman told employees in a LinkedIn memo that the move “was not made to reduce costs or replace people with AI,” positioning it instead as adapting the organization to a new AI-first vision the company laid out roughly a year ago when it rebranded around a platform-wide AI push. Monday.com, which has two offices in the U.S., expects $45 million to $55 million in net restructuring charges but still projects up to 20% year-over-year revenue growth for 2026.

claims.subject: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for
claims.object: — here are 20 others
claims.quote: Still, the picture isn’t uniformly bleak. The FT notes that AI-focused companies like Anthropic and OpenAI are hiring rapidly, absorbing some of the talent shed elsewhere in the industry. And within some of the very companies making cuts, headcount is shifting rather than disappearing entirely. Meta, for instance, earlier this year moved roughly 7,000 employees into new AI-focused roles even as it laid off 8,000 others, and IBM says it’s tripling entry-level hiring for AI and hybrid-cloud roles alongside recent cuts.

claims.object: approved by judge
claims.quote: A federal judge has signed off on Anthropic’s $1.5 billion class action settlement with authors who accused the company of training its AI models on copyrighted books, as reported earlier by Reuters . In an order on Monday , Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín writes that the settlement will provide “meaningful relief,” offering authors around $3,000 for each book allegedly pirated by Anthropic.

claims.subject: Anthropic’s $1.5 billion book piracy
claims.object: approved by judge
claims.quote: The $1.5 billion settlement is the “largest known copyright recovery in history,” according to the law firm representing the plaintiffs . A group of authors — Andrea Bartz, Charles Graeber, and Kirk Wallace Johnson — first filed a copyright lawsuit against Anthropic in 2024. While the now-retired Judge William Alsup granted Anthropic a partial victory last year, he approved a separate class action lawsuit claiming the company engaged in the “Napster-style downloading of millions of works.” Anthropic agreed to a $1.5 billion settlement in September 2025, to which Judge Alsup later granted preliminary approval .

claims.subject: Anthropic’s $1.5 billion book piracy
claims.object: approved by judge
claims.quote: “We are pleased that more than 91% of authors and publishers covered by the settlement have claimed their share of the payment,” Anthropic general counsel Aparna Sridhar tells Reuters . “We’re looking forward ​to bringing this matter to a close.” Anthropic is still facing copyright lawsuits from Chicken Soup for the Soul and several other authors who argue that $3,000 per book isn’t enough.

claims.subject: Perplexity
claims.object: WANDR，评估智能体的广泛搜索与深度验证能力
claims.quote: Perplexity released WANDR (Wide ANd Deep Research) . It is an open benchmark and evaluation harness. It is built around 500 realistic, challenging data-collection tasks for knowledge work. WANDR is the wide sibling of Perplexity’s DRACO benchmark for deep research. DRACO asks whether an agent produces an accurate, complete, objective long-form report. WANDR instead asks whether it can build a large collection with evidence.

claims.subject: Perplexity
claims.object: WANDR，评估智能体的广泛搜索与深度验证能力
claims.quote: At its core, WANDR tests two demands together. Wide means discovering a large, often open-ended set of qualifying entities. Deep means investigating every entity enough to support each claim with evidence. Combining both changes the problem for agents. A few compelling examples are not enough here. A polished narrative built on incomplete research also falls short.

claims.subject: Perplexity
claims.object: WANDR，评估智能体的广泛搜索与深度验证能力
claims.quote: To capture this, WANDR uses a composable qualification key hierarchy . One task might request company(n) -> employee(m) -> url(k) . This means n qualifying companies, m employees each, and k supporting pages each. Every complete path through the tree gets validated independently. The same structure can represent a flat list, nested search, or matrix.

events.title: Kimi K3 与 Claude 对比：质量相当但价格更低，美国AI政策成败笔
events.subject: Kimi K3 与 Claude 对比：质量相当但价格更低，美国AI
events.object: 成败笔

claims.subject: Kimi K3 与 Claude 对比：质量相当但价格更低，美国AI
claims.object: 成败笔
claims.quote: Step back and the bigger story is what an unmitigated failure US AI policy has been. The administration held Fable back, and what finally shipped is a hindered version that refuses whole categories of work. Meanwhile a frontier quality model with none of those restrictions is a download away, released by a Chinese lab the US government has no ability to regulate. Whatever the theory behind gating American models was, it plainly wasn’t thought through, because the only people the gates constrain are American customers. Semgrep found GLM 5.2 beating Claude on their cyber benchmarks for exactly this reason. The restricted model declines the work and the open one just does it.

claims.subject: Kimi K3 与 Claude 对比：质量相当但价格更低，美国AI
claims.object: 成败笔
claims.quote: I’ve been running Kimi K3 alongside Claude on my normal coding work, and for all practical purposes I can’t tell them apart. Same tasks, same quality of output, and near identical token counts to get there. I expected an open model to be sloppier or to grind through more tokens on the way to the same answer, and neither turned out to be true.

claims.subject: Kimi K3 与 Claude 对比：质量相当但价格更低，美国AI
claims.object: 成败笔
claims.quote: The prices are nowhere near each other. K3’s API runs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output. Claude’s top model costs $10 and $50 for the same units. The subscription side is even more lopsided. Kimi’s paid plans start at $19 a month, and the $39 coding tier is far more generous than anything Claude sells anywhere near that price. Claude’s plans are metered tightly enough that a normal day of agent work can chew through the allowance before lunch.

claims.subject: Kimi K3 与 Claude 对比：质量相当但价格更低，美国AI
claims.object: 成败笔
claims.quote: Then there’s the fine print. Claude couldn’t sustain Fable access on the twenty dollar plan, so they turned it off, and the plan quietly falls back to Opus. When the headline model on your plan can be switched off because the economics don’t work, the plan was never really selling you the headline model. Kimi’s tiers don’t come with that asterisk.

claims.subject: Moonshot AI

PerceptionBench is built to expose exactly where perception breaks, and to drive progress toward multimodal AI that sees faithfully and consistently.

claims.subject: Google

claims.quote: Europe wasted no time using its landmark Digital Markets Act (DMA) to try and rein in Big Tech. Companies like Apple, Meta, and Google have faced steep fines and orders to modify their business practices since the law came into force in 2024. And the hits keep on coming for Big Tech in Europe. After several months of consideration, the European Commission has announced new DMA measures that will force Google to support interoperability and competition in the European Union, and Google is not happy about it.

claims.subject: Google
claims.object: Google 在 Android 上共享搜索数据并开放 AI
claims.quote: The new “specification measures” cover two elements of Google’s business: Android phones and search. Both changes could theoretically increase competition and give users more choices, but Google claims they will undermine privacy and security. But as a “gatekeeper” under the DMA, Google has no choice but to comply. As the European Commission points out in its announcement, these decisions are legally binding.

claims.subject: Google
claims.object: Google 在 Android 上共享搜索数据并开放 AI
claims.quote: Similarly, Google contends that sharing search data as the EU now demands will risk user privacy. The DMA action calls on Google to anonymize data using a multilayered approach, and the Commission is open to amending its decision to ensure identifiable data is appropriately handled. Google acknowledges that regulators are open to adjusting the rules, but Walker still characterizes this ruling as a threat to privacy, business trade secrets, and even national security.

claims.subject: Google
claims.object: Google 在 Android 上共享搜索数据并开放 AI
claims.quote: On Android, Google will have to open up access to competing AI platforms. Currently, Google’s Gemini gets preferential access to the system. Gemini is preloaded on all Google-certified Android phones and can wake up in response to the “Hey Google” hot word. Google’s AI also includes system and app automation features, screen content access, and more.

events.title: 确保AI智能体安全的多层策略
events.originalTitle: Multi-Layer Policy for Securing AI Agents
events.subject: Multi-Layer
events.object: for Securing AI Agents

claims.subject: Multi-Layer
claims.object: for Securing AI Agents
claims.quote: As part of our work at Tigera building products that create secure runtime environments for enterprise agents at scale in the real world, one small part of this puzzle I think about a lot is policy, and runtime enforcement of policy, and how to create a comprehensive secure runtime, configured from one place. The more companies we talk to trying to lock down and secure these platforms at runtime, the more I believe AI Agent security needs policy in multiple places, not just one (e.g., not just at the gateway layer), and ideally expressed in the same policy language.

claims.subject: Multi-Layer
claims.object: for Securing AI Agents
claims.quote: At the L7 gateway layer, every agent call is observable: who is calling, what they are calling, what attributes both sides carry, what the requested action is. This is where you decide whether an agent should be permitted to talk to a particular MCP server, invoke a particular tool, delegate to another agent, or call a particular LLM. The atoms of policy here are identity, action, resource, and context.

claims.subject: Multi-Layer
claims.object: for Securing AI Agents
claims.quote: At the agent runtime layer, or kernel layer in a container, what the agent does inside its own runtime is observable: syscalls, file access, library loads, network connections that bypass the brokered channel. This is where you decide whether the agent can read a file, open a socket, spawn a subprocess, or load a library. The atoms of policy here are processes, paths, file descriptors, and system calls.

claims.subject: Multi-Layer
claims.object: for Securing AI Agents
claims.quote: Both layers are necessary. The gateway alone cannot constrain what an agent does inside its runtime once it holds a token. The kernel alone cannot reason about identity, delegation, or multi-hop intent. Building policy at one and not the other leaves a category gap.

events.sourceExcerpt: As part of our work at Tigera building products that create secure runtime environments for enterprise agents at scale in the real world, one small part of this puzzle I think about a lot is policy, and runtime enforcement of policy, and how to create a comprehensive secure runtime, configured from one place. The more companies we talk to trying to lock down and secure these platforms at runtime, the more I believe AI Agent security needs policy in multiple places, not just one (e.g., not just at the gateway layer), and ideally expressed in the same policy language.

claims.subject: 爱沙尼亚语言研究所
claims.object: 测试：衡量AI模型对俄罗斯宣传的易感性
claims.quote: The Institute of the Estonian Language has released a benchmark measuring how susceptible AI language models are to Russian propaganda. Sixty models were tested with 75 questions in three languages covering 14 propaganda narratives, phrased in neutral, biased, and manipulative ways. Each answer is scored on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 means the model repeats Russian talking points.

claims.subject: 爱沙尼亚语言研究所
claims.object: 测试：衡量AI模型对俄罗斯宣传的易感性
claims.quote: A calibrated Claude Opus 4.5 served as the evaluation model, validated by disinformation experts at the organization Propastop . Anthropic's Claude models claimed the top spots, followed by Nvidia's Nemotron 3 and Alibaba's Qwen 3.6 Plus . Mistral's models, including the newest Medium 3.5 , landed in the bottom third. The models had no access to web search or other tools during testing, so the benchmark only measures how well the language model itself can spot and reject propaganda.

claims.subject: 爱沙尼亚语言研究所
claims.object: 测试：衡量AI模型对俄罗斯宣传的易感性
claims.quote: Anthropic models dominate the benchmark for detecting Russian disinformation: Claude Fable 5, which is currently disabled outside the U.S., leads with a score of 95.2, followed by Claude Opus 4.7.

public_profile.summary: 艾智远是趋境科技 CEO，具备清华计算机博士背景，研究和工程经验涉及分布式系统优化、并行计算与分布式存储。他曾在深信服担任多个大数据、数字化和 AI 应用部门的研发主管，之后创业推动 AI Infra 与大模型推理基础设施产品化。公开采访称趋境科技由清华计算机系教授与真知创投发起，核心创始团队出身于同一学术团队。

founderEvidence.quote: 两位首席科学家提供关键技术纵深。王鑫曾任百度量子计算研究所Tech Leader，主导研发工业级量子软件平台“量桨”，长期从事量子算法、量子信息与量子人工智能研究，在PRL、PRX Quantum、Nature Computational Science、IEEE TIT、NeurIPS、AAAI、ISCA、HPCA、MICRO 等顶刊和顶会发表论文百余篇，主持和参与量子算法与量超融合方向的国自然重大研究计划和国家重点研发计划。刘金国曾在全球中性原子量子计算领军团队——哈佛大学 Lukin 组从事博士后研究，并在其孵化的全球头部中性原子量子计算公司QuEra 任全职顾问，深度参与QuEra 团队组建与软件栈建设，系统积累了从理论、软件到硬件映射的复合经验。刘金国长期深耕中性原子体系模拟、量子算法和组合优化，是国内量子软件开源社区核心布道者之一，也是 Yao.jl 主要贡献者之一。

public_profile.summary: 刘金国是幻码跃迁联合创始人及首席科学家，长期研究中性原子量子计算、量子算法与组合优化。投资界对公司的融资报道介绍，他曾在哈佛大学 Lukin 研究组从事博士后研究，后任 QuEra 全职顾问并参与团队组建和软件栈建设，也是 Yao.jl 主要贡献者之一。详细学位、任职时间线未公开。

track_record.description: Baidu Investor Relations 于 2011 年公告，公司承诺对去哪儿网进行 3.06 亿美元战略投资。公告以百度公司名义披露，没有将交易归属到特定内部部门。
Baidu Investor Relations 于 2016 年公告百度、腾讯和京东各自同意购买易车新发行股份，金额各为 5,000 万美元；公告没有确认由百度战投团队执行。
百度智能云官方合作伙伴页面称宇信科技于 2020 年初获得来自百度的战略投资，双方随后在金融云、大数据、AI 和区块链等领域合作；页面未披露百度战投部门或单独投资金额。
投资界 2026 年报道物自体科技（Noumena）后续融资时，回顾其此前数千万元 Pre-A 轮并将百度战投列为投资方；该报道没有披露百度的单笔出资，也未把百度战投列为后续轮出资方。
投资界 2026 年报道将百度战投列入智平方 B 轮投资方，但未披露百度单独出资金额；同一轮次涉及多家投资方。
RobotHub 的公司档案将百度战投列入智平方 B 轮，并列示该轮总额为人民币 10 亿元；此为轮次总额，不是百度战投的单笔金额。

public_profile.summary: Scaleup Europe Fund is a European growth and late-stage technology fund managed by EQT and backed by the European Commission and institutional investors. It targets €5 billion and focuses on strategic technologies from Series B through pre-IPO. In September 2026, the fund co-led Mistral AI’s €3 billion Series D, with Samsung Electronics leading, and co-led EUCLYD’s €200 million-plus Series A. Neither company disclosed the fund’s individual commitment.

sources.source_title: 大模型公司面壁智能完成数亿元融资 投后估值迈入独角兽门槛|智能_新浪财经_新浪网
sources.quote: 会！ （来源：财联社） 《科创板日报》4月9日讯（记者 李明明） 近日，国内基座大模型企业面壁智能正式宣布完成新一轮数亿元人民币融资。本轮融资由深创投、 汇川技术 旗下汇川产投联合领投，道禾长期投资、 国泰海通 创新投、武岳峰科创等多家头部机构跟投。 《科创板日报》记者从相关方获悉， 这是面壁智能2026年完成的第二笔融资，叠加春节后由 中国电信 领投的首轮融资，公司一季度累计融资规模已超10亿元人民币，投后估值迈入独角兽门槛， 也正式跻身国内具备全栈自研能力的基座大模型独角兽企业行列。 双城“押注” 面壁智能脱胎于清华大学计算机系自然语言处理与社会人文计算实验室，其模型研发与训练基地位于北京。北京方面在此前融资中已通过京国瑞、北京市人工智能产业投资基金等渠道完成资本布局

public_profile.summary: UVC Partners is a Munich- and Berlin-based European venture firm investing in B2B technology from early stages through growth. Founded in 2011, it focuses on DeepTech, ClimateTech, Mobility and Software/AI, and works closely with the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem. In 2026 the firm reported more than €700 million in assets under management and €400 million in newly raised capital for technology founders.

sources.quote: CSG完成数亿元Pre-A轮融资 OpenCSG完成数亿元Pre-A轮融资 2026年08月31日 15:29 投中网 新浪财经APP 缩小字体 放大字体 收藏 微博 微信 分享 腾讯QQ QQ空间 本轮融资由静安资本、市北高新、徐汇资本、黄海金控等共同参与。此前，OpenCSG已获得联想创投、北京国信中数、中科升哲等机构投资。 近日，开放传神（OpenCSG）宣布完成数亿元人民币Pre-A轮融资，投后估值迈入独角兽级别。本轮融资由静安资本、市北高新、徐汇资本、黄海金控等共同参与。此前，OpenCSG已获得联想创投、北京国信中数、中科升哲等机构投资。 本轮融资完成后，OpenCSG将进一步加大在开源AI基础设施、Agentic AI平台、全球开发者生态及城市级AI基础设施

sources.source_title: 头部智能眼镜品牌完成近10亿C轮融资，已正式启动上市筹备工作｜硬氪首发-36氪
sources.quote: 氪首发 黄 楠 · 2026年09月09日 09:00 近年来影目科技营收增速连续保持200%以上。 作者｜黄楠 编辑｜袁斯来 硬氪获悉，全球智能眼镜品牌「影目科技」近日完成C3轮融资，由四川振兴科创基金领投，静安资本、市北高新、广州产投、四川中试、眉山中试及东坡国投跟投。继年初完成C1、C2轮融资后，公司C轮融资累计金额近10亿元。 本轮资金将主要用于新一代空间智能硬件产品线的研发落地，及INMO AIOS 系统的持续迭代升级，加强硬件与软件底层核心能力构建；同时，加大品牌建设与全渠道布局，完善商业化能力，推动产品破圈，实现业务加速增长。 目前，影目科技已正式启动上市筹备工作，近年来公司营收增速连续保持200%以上。 智能眼镜正在被推向消费电子领域最受关注的位置。IDC

public_profile.summary: Inovia Capital 是成立于 2007 年、以加拿大为根基并投资北美和欧洲公司的多阶段风险投资机构，投资从 pre-seed 延伸至 pre-IPO，通过 Discovery、Venture 与 Growth 三类策略覆盖基金与直接投资、早期成长及后续轮次。Venture 策略重点关注 AI/ML、金融科技、数字健康、网络安全、基础设施与开发运维、未来工作等方向；Growth 平台提供人才、产品与技术、企业发展和市场传播支持。官网自报管理资产 25 亿美元、累计投资 300 多家公司、65 笔退出及 31 亿美元以上退出价值，页面未注明统计时点。创办人 Shawn Abbott 与 Chris Arsenault 仍列为现任合伙人。Katalyze AI 官方公告称其 1,050 万美元种子轮由 Bonfire Ventures 领投，Inovia 等机构参与；金额为整轮融资总额。

sources.source_title: 国泰海通开元投资有限公司｜公司简介
sources.quote: 国泰海通开元投资有限公司（简称“国泰海通开元”）成立于2008年，是国泰海通证券全资所有的私募投资基金子公司，注册资本为55亿元，管理资金规模近1300亿元。

sources.source_title: 国泰海通开元投资有限公司｜业务模式
sources.quote: 国泰海通开元的业务模式分为两类：一是，国泰海通开元以母基金形式发起设立私募股权投资基金，并控股相应的基金管理人。目前，国泰海通开元旗下设有7家基金管理子公司，共管理122余只基金的投资运作；二是，国泰海通开元作为国泰海通证券的私募投资基金子公司，直接从事一级市场私募股权投资基金管理业务。目前，国泰海通开元投资团队直接管理的私募股权投资基金为19只。

sources.source_title: 国泰海通开元投资有限公司｜截至2024年底的上市案例数据
sources.quote: 截至2024年12月31日，国泰海通开元及旗下管理公司的被投资企业中，累计上市项目（含借壳、并购）逾130家。

sources.source_title: 国泰海通开元投资有限公司｜管理团队
sources.quote: 国泰海通开元投资管理团队具备深厚的专业知识、广阔的投资视野、稳健的投资风格和多年市场磨砺的深刻经验，通过整合国泰海通证券“一体化”资源、发扬自身优势和特点，为被投资企业提供增值及全方位的资本市场服务。

sources.source_title: 首支人工智能基金设立 南通产控思源人工智能先导基金签约活动举行-南通市人民政府
sources.quote: 南通产控思源人工智能先导基金是南通市首支人工智能主题专项基金，也是上海高校与南通国资合作的首支人工智能直投基金，基金规模3.5亿元，聚焦人工智能前沿赛道与新质生产力培育，重点布局数据、算法、智能制造、脑机接口、Al+等领域的中早期项目。基金由南通产控集团牵头设立，南通投管担任基金管理人，联合南通开控集团、菡源资产共同发起设立，采用双GP市场化运作模式，深度链接上海交大科研资源与校友生态，依托产控集团的产业资源与南通投管的专业投资能力，助力南通打造人工智能产业高地。

sources.source_title: 首发| 奕行智能完成新一轮20亿元融资，投后估值近150亿_投资界
sources.quote: 片独角兽奕行智能（北京）科技股份有限公司（简称“奕行智能”）完成新一轮20亿元融资，据估计投后估值接近150亿元。 这是继上半年获15亿元B轮及中国移动战略投资后，公司短短数月内完成的又一次大额融资，阵容豪华——汇聚了 华泰创新、钟鼎资本、中芯聚源、九安医疗、仁爱资本、通富微电子、赛意产业基金、和利资本、芯鑫租赁、恒旭资本、尚颀资本、建广湛卢、容亿资本 等超20家知名投资机构。 至此，奕行智能身后云集一众知名国资、财务及产业投资人。大家集体押注的，正是有着芯片“开源革命”之称的RISC-V——一个完全开放、免费、可定制的精简指令集，及其在云端算力的竞争优势。不久前，RISC-V在人工智能和嵌入式系统领域的重要性被写入电子信息制造业发展“十五五”规划，产业意味不言而喻。 2

sources.source_title: 华泰创新
sources.quote: 华泰创新 一、 公司简介 华泰创新投资有限公司是华泰证券下设的全资另类投资子公司，注册资本35亿元。在法律法规及监管规定的框架下，华泰创新使用自有资金开展金融科技股权投资、科创板业务、战略投资等创新型投资业务。 二、 制度建设情况 华泰创新作为华泰证券的一级全资子公司，将制度建设作为重要工作，根据《证券公司另类投资子公司管理规范》、《证券公司全面风险管理规范》、《关于证券公司证券自营业务投资范围及有关事项的规定》、《证券公司内部控制指引》等法律法规及监管规

sources.quote: 科技产业投资业务是发行人最主要的业务，主要由高新创投公司和禾合创投公司负责。发行人作为杭州高新区（滨江）产业扶持资金运营管理机构，拥有完整的“投融管退”业务流程，充分利用政府资金优势，孵化培育杭州高新区（滨江）的科技创新企业，并通过直接投资、子基金投资或战略合作投资的方式来扶持杭州高新区（滨江）的科技创新企业发展，同时通过撬动社会资本来提升杭州高新区（滨江）内的科技创新产业投资规模，促进产业集聚。科技产业投资方向主要为半导体、信息技术、云服务、大数据、物联网、医疗健康、文化创意、高端制造等高新技术产业，投资标的多为处于初创期和成长期的公司。

sources.quote: 发行人的子基金投资业务主要由高新创投公司和禾合创投公司负责。发行人以政府产业扶持资金及自筹资金作为资金来源，以阶段性参股方式与社会资本合作成立子基金，通过社会投资机构管理及市场化运作，引导社会资本对杭州高新区（滨江）科技创新企业进行投资。一般情况下，子基金由专业化的社会投资机构担任GP，并由其进行基金投资项目的筛选和管理，禾合创投公司亦具备私募基金管理人资格，也可作为执行事务合伙人和基金管理人。

sources.source_title: 杭州市国有资本投资运营有限公司官网
sources.quote: 以党建链赋能创新链 服务产业链——杭州资本与余杭国投、君联资本开展党建共建活动 2024年11月04日 为充分推动党建与业务融合发展，积极构建党建链与创新链、产业链融合共促的良好态势，10月25日，杭州资本与余杭国投、君联资本开展以“赓续中华文脉 传承红色基因”为主题的党建共建活动。杭州资本党委书记、董事长孙刚锋， 余杭国投集团党委书记、董事长孟志刚 ， 君联资本党支部书记、君联资本副董事长陈浩 ， 君联资本党支部副书记、君联资本总裁李家庆 一行出席活动。 在良渚博物馆，共建单位一行充分领略中华五千多年文明史，深入学习习近平总书记关于良渚文化的批示指示精神，深刻感悟习近平文化思想的博大内涵。在深睿医疗公司，充分了解企业积极响应“加快发展新质生产力”号召，通过突破性的人工智能“深度学习”技术及自主研发的核心算法，赋能医疗服务机构实现智能化升级与转型的具体实践。在座谈交流环节，共建单位各方分享了企业党建工作经验，并对后续投资形势和基金业务开展等进行了深入交流。

milestones.description: 公司成立日期见上市公司披露的基金合作公告。
集团参与签署金华市启真科创创业投资基金合伙协议；集团认缴1800万元、占基金总认缴额18%，身份为有限合伙人。
浙报数字文化公告称金华市启真科创创业投资基金完成中国证券投资基金业协会备案。
集团与浙大创新院、浙江省智能诊疗设备制造业创新中心签署战略合作协议，推动医疗器械领域的成果转化与产业科创生态建设。
浙报数字文化公告披露金华市启真科创创业投资基金累计实缴1亿元、实缴比例100%；该为整支基金口径，不等于集团单独出资额。

track_record.description: 浙数文化2024年公告引用启真创投披露：其通过基金参投的已上市项目达13个，列出的案例包括禾迈股份、柯力传感、扬帆新材、中泰证券、泰豪科技、元成园林、双枪科技和创远仪器。此为全资子公司管理人按“基金参投”统计的案例，不是集团直投清单，也不代表集团全部组合。
金华市启真科创创业投资基金总认缴规模1亿元，集团认缴1800万元、占18%，以有限合伙人身份参与；浙江浙大启真创投为全资子公司，并担任基金管理人及普通合伙人之一。
2023年城西科创制造业股权投资母基金认缴总额为40亿元，集团是有限合伙人之一并获委派1名投资决策委员会委员；披露未列出集团自身认缴金额，因此不把40亿元计为集团出资。
2025年集团参与医疗器械产业战略合作，公告提到将探索设立科创投资基金，并结合科创供应链与产业赋能体系推进成果转化；这是合作安排，不作为已完成投资或投资回报证明。

public_profile.summary: 融资数据库中的“龙岗引导基金”可与龙岗区政策性投资引导基金对应。它是区级政府投资基金体系，通过与专业创投机构合作设立子基金，撬动社会资本支持龙岗产业；深圳市龙岗区人民政府2026年披露其合作子基金38支、总规模约998.55亿元，近三年布局半导体、人工智能、生物医药和机器人等方向。

public_profile.coverage_note: 融资报道使用“湖北长江产业投资集团”这一简称。上交所2026年募集说明书记载，发行人曾用名“湖北省长江产业投资集团有限公司”，2022年2月更名为“长江产业投资集团有限公司”；官方沿革支持将该简称按现行集团档案整理。集团官网概况页把336亿元标为注册资本，而2026年募集说明书列示注册资本32.505亿元、实缴资本336.395615亿元；本档案分开记录法定注册和实缴口径。

sources.source_title: 走进公司｜浙江九纬私募基金管理有限公司
sources.quote: 浙江九纬私募基金管理有限公司成立于2017年，是一家专业的私募股权投资管理机构，已取得中国证券投资基金业协会备案的私募投资基金管理人资格（备案号：P1064271），公司专注医疗、科技、进口替代、先进制造的实业投资，管理团队已成功发行并管理规模约5亿元的投资基金。公司拥有一支专业、守信勤业、经验丰富的投资管理团队，项目和资源广泛，擅长企业间资源整合，资本运作，专注于投资Pre-IPO及高成长性新三板企业，现已发行8支基金，基金累计投资20多个项目。

public_profile.summary: Blume Founders Fund（BFF）是印度早期投资机构 Blume Ventures 发起的创办人网络投资项目，官方称其与核心投资计划区分运作，重点支持与 Blume 有既有关系的创办人。2023 年官网文章称，Fund IV 拨出 2%–3% 资金用于 BFF，投资额为 5 万至 25 万美元，面向 Pre-Seed、Seed 和 Pre-Series A 项目；文中也称 BFF 不做后续轮投资。官网将该项目归于 Network Investment Programs，由 Sarita Raichura 负责。该页面是 2023 年披露，不能据此推断当前条款未变化。

facts.label: 项目性质
facts.value: Blume Ventures 的创办人网络投资项目；官网明确表示其区别于 Blume 核心投资计划。应将本库的 BFF 记录理解为项目/投资计划身份，不据此推断其为独立法律基金。

facts.label: 官网 2023 年披露的项目条款
facts.value: 2023 年官网文章称，Blume Fund IV（该文披露规模为 $292m）拨出 2%–3% 给 BFF；单笔投资约 $50k–$250k，面向 Pre-Seed、Seed 与 Pre-Series A；文章称项目不提供后续轮投资。此为 2023 年披露，条款可能已变化。

facts.label: 官网披露的创办人关系基础
facts.value: 官网称 BFF 面向与 Blume 有较强联系的创办人，例如 Blume 校友、组合公司 CXO、接受过 Blume 创办人辅导者，或与机构长期建立联系者。

facts.label: 项目负责人
facts.value: Blume 官网将 Sarita Raichura 列为 Network Investment Programs Director，并称她负责 BFF。她曾任 Indian Angel Network 区域负责人、在 Intel Technologies 全球市场规模与预测团队工作，拥有 Thunderbird School of Global Management 国际管理硕士学位；官网还称她在印度创业生态有 8 年以上经验。以上为本人机构官网简介。

facts.label: BFF 投后支持
facts.value: 官网称 BFF 组合公司可使用 Blume 创办人网络、内部资源手册、学习发展活动、法律/财务/税务及招聘合作伙伴，并获得 Blume 团队指导。

sources.source_title: About Us | Palo Alto Networks
sources.quote: Nikesh Arora is chairman and CEO of Palo Alto Networks. Before joining Palo Alto Networks in 2018, Mr. Arora served as president and chief operating officer of SoftBank Group Corp. Prior to that, Mr. Arora spent ten years at Google, Inc. as a senior executive, where he was senior vice president and chief business officer, president of global sales operations and business development, and president of Europe, the Middle East and Africa. His career also includes serving as chief marketing officer for the T-Mobile International Division of Deutsche Telekom AG, and chief executive officer and founder of T-Motion PLC, which merged with T-Mobile International in 2002. Nikesh Arora serves on the board of Uber Technologies, Inc., and as a non-executive director of Compagnie Financière Richemont S.A. He holds an M.B.A. in business administration from Northeastern University, an M.S. in finance from Boston College, and a B. Tech. in electrical engineering from the Institute of Technology at Banaras Hindu University.

sources.quote: Geoffrey Hinton received his BA in Experimental Psychology from Cambridge in 1970 and his PhD in Artificial Intelligence from Edinburgh in 1978. He did postdoctoral work at Sussex University and the University of California San Diego and spent five years as a faculty member in the Computer Science department at Carnegie-Mellon University. He then became a fellow of the Canadian Institute for Advanced Research and moved to the Department of Computer Science at the University of Toronto. He spent three years from 1998 until 2001 setting up the Gatsby Computational Neuroscience Unit at University College London and then returned to the University of Toronto where he is now an emeritus distinguished professor. From 2004 until 2013 he was the director of the program on "Neural Computation and Adaptive Perception" which is funded by the Canadian Institute for Advanced Research. From 2013 to 2023 he worked half-time at Google where he became a Vice President and Engineering Fellow. Geoffrey Hinton is a fellow of the UK Royal Society, the Royal Society of Canada, the Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence and a former president of the Cognitive Science Society.

public_profile.summary: Galaxy Ventures 是 Galaxy 的加密资产风险投资团队，2018 年起曾以 Galaxy 资产负债表开展投资，2024 年启动首只外部风险投资基金 GVF I。该基金于 2025 年完成超过 1.75 亿美元募集承诺，主要投资链上经济相关的早期基础设施、区块链协议、金融化应用和软件基础设施。团队提供覆盖公司建设、设计、传播、人才与业务拓展的投后平台支持。

facts.label: 机构背景
facts.value: Galaxy Ventures 隶属 Galaxy 体系；官网称 Galaxy Asset Management 是 Galaxy Digital Inc. 的关联公司，并由其宣布 GVF I 募集完成。

facts.label: Galaxy Ventures Fund I 募集
facts.value: GVF I 于 2025-06-26 完成募集，资本承诺超过 1.75 亿美元，高于 1.5 亿美元目标；这是基金募集额，不是投资回报或基金资产净值。

facts.label: 累计投资案例（截至 2025 年披露）

facts.label: 投资团队负责人
facts.value: William（Will）Nuelle 与 Mike Giampapa 为普通合伙人。Nuelle 关注协议基础设施、DeFi 和软件，曾在 Galaxy Research 开发交易量化风险软件；拥有 Stanford 数学与建筑学理学学士学位。

facts.label: Mike Giampapa 履历
facts.value: 加入 Galaxy 前曾在 Bessemer Venture Partners 参与加密及金融科技投资，并在 Institutional Venture Partners 参与 Coinbase 领投项目；此前任职 JPMorgan、Circle。拥有 Harvard Business School MBA 及 Johns Hopkins 经济学学士学位。

sources.source_title: AI旅行服务平台「玩点旅行」完成超亿元Pre-A轮融资_投资界
sources.quote: 技术风险，建议结合行业发展趋势评估。 投资界（ID：pedaily2012）6月9日消息， AI旅行服务平台北京玩点旅行有限公司（以下简称： 玩点旅行 ）于近期完成 超1亿元人民币Pre-A轮 融资。本轮融资由 敦鸿资产 领投， 财通资本、头头是道、源铄资本 跟投，同时 DeepSeek部分股东 同步加码增持。本轮资金将重点投入AI Agent技术的深度研发与场景落地，加速B端产业AI生产力解决方案与C端智能出行体验的双向升级。 玩点旅行成立于2021年，致力于打造去中心化流量趋势下旅行行业的全新生态解决方案，以AI技术为核心底座、AI智能体为落地工具，让更多旅游企业能够即插即用地接入AI生产力，让更多用户享受到真正智能的出行服务，最终为万亿级旅行产业升级提供持续支撑。

public_profile.summary: Enza Capital 是一家投资非洲科技企业的多阶段风险投资机构，官网披露其首笔投资覆盖 Pre-seed 至 Series B，关注金融科技、AI、物流、人力资本、教育、气候与能源、网络安全及医疗健康。机构由 David Cohen、John Lazar 与 Mike Mompi 创立，并由 Nzwisisa Chidembo 担任驻场技术负责人；团队横跨全球投资、软件公司经营、非洲早期投资和创业公司规模化经验。

sources.source_title: 【会员动态】AI芯片设计商「墨芯人工智能」获得近10亿人民币C轮融资_新浪财经_新浪网
sources.quote: MD 微信 腾讯QQ QQ空间 （来源：合肥市投资基金协会） 5月28日，墨芯人工智能宣布完成近十亿元C轮融资。本轮投资方包括深创投、 岩山科技 、大湾区共同家园、 我会会员单位力鼎资本 、蕴盛资本等，老股东凯旋创投、创享投资、盛景嘉成共同参与。 公司专注于稀疏计算AI芯片，通过剔除矩阵运算中的无效计算，实现算力倍增与功耗大幅下降。核心产品SparsePrime®计算卡将于年内推出，基于自研Antoum 2.0架构，专为大模型与复杂推理场景优化，支持主流Transformer模型，配备完善工具链，可实现PyTorch/TensorFlow代码近乎零修改部署。此前，墨芯S30、S40计算卡在MLPerf™ Inference中连续三届夺冠，视觉、自然语言处理等任务上以远低于行业旗舰产品的功耗达成更优推理性能。

sources.quote: 凯旋创投，成立于2008年，是中国优秀的高科技创业投资基金之一。凯旋创投深耕高科技领域，致力于寻找早中期和成长期的高潜力科技企业，在战略新兴产业中的物联网、人工智能、智能硬件、先进医疗等主要关注领域，持续挖掘投资机会，团队拥有丰富的技术行业经验和坚实的高科技产业背景，积累了大量的投资经验，具备跨越周期的投资能力。

sources.quote: 周志雄，凯旋创投创始合伙人，是中国最活跃的风险投资人之一。专注于寻找技术驱动型的投资机会，尤其关注人工智能、云技术与大数据、半导体、先进医疗等领域。曾任职于软银中国风险投资基金负责北京业务，2001年加入软银亚洲基础设施基金，后担任软银赛富（SAIF）基金合伙人，并参与创立凯鹏华盈首支中国基金并任合伙人。

sources.quote: 万利达集团创立于1984年，是国内工业化和信息化智能制造领域领先的科技企业集团。多年来，集团持续专注于智能消费类电子及显示产品的研、产、销，并不断提升工业自动化服务能力。目前，集团旗下拥有万利达（malata）、盈趣（intretech）、厦华（prima）三大品牌，形成以厨卫电器、智能商显、移动通信、智能控制、环境电器等为主的多元化产业集群。集团总部位于中国厦门，在深圳、漳州、厦门等地设有三大专业规模生产基地，两大研发管理运营中心。凭借自身过硬的制造实力和完善的服务体系，旗下企业产品销往全球70多个国家和地区。

sources.source_title: 公司 - CPE源峰官网
sources.quote: CPE源峰是一家具有国际视野和丰富中国经验的资产管理机构，旨在运用长远眼光和价值投资策略，系统性布局AI全产业、先进制造、消费、医疗、基础设施等领域的多元化投资主题与赛道，专注于为重点行业的龙头企业提供创新性的投资方案。目前，CPE源峰在管基金已获得海内外200多家机构投资者的信任与支持。公司核心团队在过去十余年投资超过300家企业，积累了深刻的行业洞察和广泛的资源网络。通过完善的投研体系和专业的投后管理能力，CPE源峰致力与被投企业建立长期合作伙伴关系，助力被投企业的可持续发展，在为投资人获取可观回报的同时，推动被投企业所处行业的整体发展，创造积极的社会影响。目前，CPE源峰在北京、上海、香港、纽约、伦敦、东京及阿布扎比等地设立办公室，累计资产管理规模超过1500亿元。

sources.source_title: 投资理念 - CPE源峰官网
sources.quote: 十余年来，CPE源峰一直是中国领先的专注于私募股权投资的资产管理公司。随着中国国民经济的发展及资本、消费和人才的跨国流动，我们也在持续地进行国内和国际扩张。我们以对所投行业及宏观环境的深入研究和专业洞察作为投资的基础。

sources.source_title: 我们的团队 - CPE源峰官网
sources.quote: 投资管理团队坚持“与被投企业携手共赢”的理念，为被投企业在公司战略及治理、人力资源、供应链管理、品牌营销和企业数字化等八大领域提供优质的运营管理提升的增值服务，并协调促进被投企业间发挥协同效应，助力被投企业的持续价值增长。

sources.source_title: 成立半年连续获数千万融资，智子芯元凭什么卡位国产算力生态？｜甲子光年_新浪财经_新浪网
sources.quote: 正的智能化效能跃迁，是让 AI智能体接管优化全流程，将计算加速任务从“工程实验”转化为“可计算的优化问题”。 「甲子光年」获悉， 智子芯元（深圳）科技有限公司已完成数千万元天使轮融资，本轮由同创伟业、钧山资本领投，老股东英诺天使与松禾资本超额跟投 。 成立仅半年，连续获得知名投资机构青睐，这背后指向一个正在加速成型的产业判断： 国产 AI基础设施正在经历一场底层范式迁移—— 计算加速的实现路径，正从“ 依赖稀缺专家手工调优”，转向“由AI接管全流程开发的复杂度”。 这一转变的意义不止于效率提升，更关乎国产算力能否真正从“ 纸面峰值”走向“业务可用”的结构性跃迁。嗅觉敏锐的资本，正在押注这一转变的确定性。 1.国产算力进入深水区， 智子芯元用“ AI+运筹”解决AI计算生态

facts.value: 曾在创业生态工作 15 年，联合创立健身科技公司 Wello 并任联合 CEO，负责工程、产品与运营；Wello 被 Weight Watchers 收购后，她在该公司负责数字产品及旧金山办公室四年。曾为 Fitbit、Samsung Next 等企业提供咨询，并任天使投资人、导师和顾问；毕业于 Dartmouth College 和 Stanford Graduate School of Business。

facts.label: Miles Cook 履历
facts.value: Bain 高级合伙人，曾参与启动其私募股权业务、亚特兰大办公室、供应链业务及 Bain Advisor Network；亦为天使投资人和创业公司顾问，曾任多家后来成功退出公司的董事。

public_profile.summary: 北京机器人产业发展投资基金（有限合伙）是北京市设立的市级政府产业基金，目标规模 100 亿元。2023 年政府遴选公告确定其围绕机器人本体、产业链零部件及产业应用开展直接股权投资；2026 年北京市国资委资料称基金由北京国管所属京国瑞与首钢集团所属京西创投共同管理，布局具身智能、核心部件、智能算力及医疗机器人。官方 2026 年资料列举宇树科技、银河通用、松延动力、星动纪元、云深处、自变量、万勋科技、星海图和云鲸等投资案例。

sources.source_title: JAFCO Asia Formally Renamed JIF Capital; Reaffirms Leadership Continuity and Regional Platform Stability
sources.quote: 11 th Mar 2026 JIF Capital Ltd. (“JIF Capital”), formerly JAFCO Investment (Asia Pacific) Ltd. (“JAFCO Asia”), today formally announced its renaming to JIF Capital, marking the next phase of its development as an independent Asia-focused venture and growth investment platform. The firm confirmed that its investment team, country leadership and regional structure remain unchanged. JIF Capital will continue operating under the same investment philosophy, governance standards and fund mandates that have guided the platform over the past decades. JIF Capital is led by Chief Executive Officer Carmen Yuen, formerly a General Partner at Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia and India, and Managing Partner Koichi Saito, previously a General Partner at KK Fund. The regional leadership team includes: • Swee Ting Pan – Managing Director. With more than 18 years of investment experience, Swee Ting leads the firm’s Shanghai and Beijing activities and has delivered exits through U.S. IPOs, A-share IPOs and strategic trade sales across Internet, Fintech and Frontier Technology sectors. • Edward Lee – Managing Director. With over 15 years leading the investment team, Edward has shaped regional investment strategy and built high-impact portfolios across Artificial Intelligence, MedTech and Circular Energy. • Supriya Singh – Senior Director & Head of Investment in Southeast Asia and India. With 14 years of experience leading investments across India, Vietnam, Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia, Supriya has spearheaded cross-border capital deployment aligned with regional fund mandates. She has worked closely with portfolio company AnyMind since 2017, supporting its acquisition of Pokkt in 2020 and leveraging the firm’s Japan network to contribute to its Tokyo Stock Exchange listing in March 2023. As part of this transition, the firm has undertaken a structured review of its regional operating model and governance framework, reaffirming its long-term mandate to deploy capital with discipline and insight to create durable value for limited partners across Asian markets. “The renaming to JIF Capital reflects continuity and institutional evolution,” said Carmen Yuen, Chief Executive Officer. “Our team, strategy and commitment to disciplined capital allocation remain unchanged.” “We remain committed to long-term partnerships with corporate leaders and institutional investors across Japan and the broader region,” said Koichi Saito, Managing Partner. “Governance, transparency and consistent regional execution continue to define our approach.” JIF Capital operates independently following its acquisition by Bee Alternatives Management Ltd. and remains headquartered in Singapore.

public_profile.summary: 央视融媒体产业投资基金（有限合伙）是一只已在中国证券投资基金业协会备案的私募股权投资基金，由海通创意私募基金管理有限公司担任管理人。该基金以媒体融合和文化科技产业为主题，公开资料披露基金总规模100亿元、首期规模37.125亿元，布局包括人工智能与媒体科技。
public_profile.coverage_note: 法律名称、基金类型、备案与运作状态以中基协公示为准；规模、发起背景和投向来自基金管理人公开材料。公开报道中的基金投资方向和上市项目不能当作投资回报。灵初智能报道列基金参与天使轮，但20亿元是公司多轮融资合计，不是基金出资额。

public_profile.summary: Blu Ventures（官网亦使用 Blu Venture Investors 名称）是美国早期网络运营者社群发展而来的风险投资机构，官网称其于 2010 年由一群企业运营者创立，后转为专门基金模式。其核心领域是网络安全与企业技术，投资范围从早期到成长阶段，主要面向美国公司。官网称机构管理多只网络安全基金，包括 2021 年推出的 2,500 万美元早期基金，以及目标规模 5,000 万美元的下一代基金策略；后者是目标而非已确认募资额。

facts.label: 成立与机构演进
facts.value: 官网称 Blu 于 2010 年由曾任企业运营者创立，起初是早期创业者社群/天使组织，后来发展为以专门基金管理外部投资者资本的风险投资机构。

facts.label: 投资主题
facts.value: 网络安全为核心，官网聚焦威胁检测、身份安全、基础设施防护及以 AI 应对新型威胁；历史专长也涵盖企业技术。

facts.label: 阶段与地域
facts.value: 官网称其支持从公司创立到规模化阶段的网络安全创新企业，总部位于华盛顿特区都会区，投资美国各地的创办团队。

facts.label: 基金结构（官网披露）
facts.value: 官网介绍有多只垂直领域微型基金、2021 年推出的 $25m 早期网络安全基金，以及目标规模 $50m 的下一代基金策略。$50m 是目标值，官网该页未确认实际募集完成。

facts.label: 团队经历：Bob Struble
facts.value: Blu 官网将 Bob Struble 列为合伙人及 Cyber Fund 投资委员会成员。官网简介称他曾任 Directed 首席执行官，并于 1996–2015 年联合创立及领导 iBiquity Digital；后者将 HD Radio 技术商业化并被 DTS 收购。该履历和成果为个人官网简介自述。

sources.quote: 上海国投先导私募基金管理有限公司（简称“上海国投先导”）成立于2024年5月，是上海国有资本投资有限公司在市国资委指导下设立的全资子公司，通过专业化的基金管理，组建三大先导产业母基金，发挥对上海市三大先导产业创新发展的战略引导功能。

sources.quote: 母基金端，上海人工智能母基金由上海国投先导管理，总规模225亿元，紧扣上海人工智能高地建设要求，依托国有资本产业牵引、生态培育双重功能，搭建前瞻性、体系化产业生态，形成覆盖算力、数据、模型、具身、端侧、应用的全栈式布局，以资本矩阵赋能人工智能产业高质量发展。

sources.source_title: 上海国投先导｜人工智能母基金
sources.quote: 人工智能母基金重点投向：通用人工智能、智能算力系统、人形机器人、垂类大模型、端侧 AI等核心技术和跨学科应用领域。

sources.source_title: About and Core Team | Cherubic Ventures
sources.quote: Prior to founding Cherubic, Matt co-founded Tian-Ge in China and 91APP in Taiwan, both of which went public at over $1B+ in market cap. … Danielle is a Partner at Cherubic Ventures and oversees Cherubic’s US investments and operations. Prior to joining Cherubic, Danielle spent nearly 8 years at Google building and leading international sales and operations teams. … Pierre is a technology entrepreneur and partner at Cherubic Ventures. Prior to joining Cherubic, Pierre co-founded Diamond, an ML startup solving data and information retrieval problems. … Tina is a Partner at Cherubic Ventures. She oversees investor relations across Asia and leads Cherubic’s investment and portfolio management activities in China.

sources.source_title: Contact | Cherubic Ventures
sources.quote: We invest in promising early-stage startups based in Greater China and the US. We are sector-agnostic and will look at any company enabled by technology. … Our first check size usually ranges from $0.5M to $1M USD. We lead and happily co-invest alongside others. … It’s never too early to start a conversation with us. We are usually the first institutional investor of the companies we invest in. … With a network across the US and Greater China, we’re eager to share best practices, business model innovation and emerging consumer trends from abroad to inspire what our founders are building locally. We love to get our hands dirty too - and happily roll up our sleeves to join your interview panels, rehearse your pitch, or introduce you to future customers/investors/domain experts. … BP/Deck Sumbission: bp@cherubic.com Media Inquiries: pr@cherubic.com

sources.source_title: 首发| 面壁智能融资超50亿，估值超200亿_投资界
sources.quote: 村科学城基金和赛富基金联合领投，北京市人工智能产业投资基金与清科创投跟投。 很快，茅台也出手了——在2025年5月与洪泰基金、国中资本、清控金信联合投资了面壁智能新一轮融资。同年12月，面壁智能完成数亿元融资，由京国瑞、国科投资、中金保时捷基金、米聚资本与和基投资共同参与。 进入2026年，面壁智能在春节之后迅速完成数亿元融资，由中国电信领投、中信金石、中信私募跟投。今年4月，再度获得新一轮数亿元融资，由深创投和汇川产投联合领投，道禾长期投资、国泰君安创新投、武岳峰科创等跟投。 伴随着此次新融资浮出水面，面壁智能估值超过200亿元后，标志其已站在全新发展节点之上，摆脱了早期创业企业的诸多不确定性，具备了对接二级市场、接受公开市场检验的核心资质。 此刻，政策信号浮现——不久前，中国证监会主席吴清在陆家嘴论坛上明确

sources.source_title: 具身智能开年最大融资，字节红杉领投10亿-36氪
sources.quote: 内已连续完成多轮融资，覆盖A+轮、A轮、Pre-A+++轮及Pre-A++轮。 从时间顺序来看，这是一条清晰的、随技术与产品推进而不断放大的融资曲线。 2025年9月8日，自变量完成近10亿元A+轮融资。 该轮由阿里云与国科投资领投，国开金融、红杉中国、渶策资本跟投，美团战投作为老股东选择超额加码，联想之星、君联资本持续追投。 融资资金主要用于全自研通用具身智能基础模型的持续训练、硬件产品研发迭代，以及开源具身大模型WALL-A的推进。 这一轮融资也有两个显著信号：一是阿里云首次明确布局具身智能赛道；二是，这是自变量第五次完成亿元级融资。 时间再往前， 2025年5月12日，自变量完成数亿元A轮融资 ，由美团战投领投，美团龙珠跟投。 该轮资金主要用于端到端通用具身智能大模型与机器人本体的同步迭代，并加速应用场景

public_profile.summary: Two Bear Capital是一家由Mike Goguen于2019年创立的早期风险投资机构，总部位于美国蒙大拿州怀特菲什，并在门洛帕克、圣迭戈、波士顿和纽约设有办公室。机构关注生命科学与技术交叉领域的创始人团队，重点包括生物技术、生物信息学、医疗信息技术、机器学习与人工智能、信息安全。官网项目申请标准主要面向总部位于美国或加拿大、处于种子轮或A轮的企业，也考虑Pre-Seed和B轮；典型首笔投资为300万至1000万美元，偏好领投或联合领投并积极参与董事会。

public_profile.summary: 北京市政府引导基金体系中的高精尖产业母基金。2015 年设立的母基金与 2023 年登记的有限合伙实体化基金属于同一政策品牌下不同层次的载体：后者规模 20 亿元，由北工投资管理。北京日报披露的超过 250 亿元认缴规模、子基金数量和投资带动数据，是母基金体系指标，不是该有限合伙实体单体业绩。融资数据库 2026 年奕行智能记录只披露基金简称，尚不能确认实际签约主体。

investors.name: 北京经开区产业升级基金(亦国投)

public_profile.summary: 北京经济技术开发区产业升级股权投资基金是北京经开区政府投资引导基金的专项子基金，采用有限合伙形式，首期规模20.01亿元，由北京亦庄国际产业投资管理有限公司担任基金管理人。该基金面向经开区重大产业项目进行直接股权投资，重点覆盖新一代信息技术、机器人与智能制造、生物医药、新能源智能汽车和数字经济，并要求投资与本地产业发展相衔接。

facts.label: 基金全称
facts.value: 北京经济技术开发区产业升级股权投资基金，简称“产业升级基金”。融资信息中的“北京经开区产业升级基金（亦国投）”为简称。

facts.label: 基金层级与用途
facts.value: 北京经开区政府投资引导基金的专项子基金，设立目的之一是对经开区重大项目开展直接股权投资。

facts.label: 首期规模
facts.value: 20.01亿元，设立信息于2023年4月由北京经开区公布。经开区政府投资引导基金首期规模100亿元为上层母基金数据，不能与本专项子基金规模混为一谈。

facts.label: 基金管理人
facts.value: 北京亦庄国际产业投资管理有限公司，负责基金日常经营管理。

facts.label: 重点投资方向
facts.value: 新一代信息技术、机器人与智能制造、生物技术与大健康、新能源智能汽车、数字经济等经开区重点产业。

facts.label: 项目与落地要求
facts.value: 被投企业原则上需在北京经开区注册、纳税并纳入统计；投资后3年内新增在区内投资原则上不低于该基金股权投资金额的2倍；单个项目投资后持股比例原则上不超过30%，且不能成为第一大股东。

facts.label: 收益与治理安排
facts.value: 基金不设置门槛收益，投资收益全部分配给出资人，基金管理人不收取超额收益；经开区工委、管委会为最高决策机构。

public_profile.summary: 碧桂园创投的官方网站以深圳市碧桂园创新投资有限公司作为版权主体。机构聚焦科技、消费、产业链与健康领域，覆盖早期VC至中后期PE，并以产业赋能和价值共创为投资理念。官网自报已投企业、IPO和独角兽数据；团队页面还公开了管理合伙人和董事总经理的教育、从业经历及代表项目。

facts.label: 官网版权主体
facts.value: 深圳市碧桂园创新投资有限公司。官网未在介绍页披露该公司的股权结构或控制关系。

facts.label: 投资主题与理念
facts.value: 聚焦科技、消费、产业链与健康，强调依托产业场景和资源赋能，促进被投企业价值提升。

facts.label: 投资阶段
facts.value: 覆盖早期VC及中后期PE。

facts.label: 官网披露投资成绩
facts.value: 官网自报已投资90余家企业，其中10家IPO、26家独角兽，另有13家完成下一轮募资；页面未标注统计日期。

facts.label: 代永波｜管理合伙人履历
facts.value: 官网称其拥有15年以上金融和产业投资经验，曾在中信建投、申银万国投行部门任职，参与或主导融资逾120亿元；上海财经大学管理学硕士、保荐代表人。官网列出其团队代表项目包括贝壳、蜂巢能源、医联健康、蓝晶微生物、新瑞鹏、菜鸟网络和追觅科技。任职年份未披露。

facts.label: 牛若磊｜管理合伙人履历
facts.value: 官网称其曾任职ING资产管理、招商基金及招商资产管理（香港），有18年以上境内外证券投资和公募基金经验，获悉尼大学金融硕士；其团队代表项目包括紫光展锐、蓝箭航天、比亚迪半导体、长鑫存储、盛合晶微、遇见小面和茶里。

facts.label: 沈烨｜管理合伙人履历
facts.value: 官网称其就读北京大学、伦敦大学学院和伦敦政治经济学院，获法律及会计学硕士，曾在君信律师事务所和海岸投资任职；在交易结构、项目执行与退出、跨境投资、法律合规方面有22年以上经验。

facts.label: 李思龙｜董事总经理履历
facts.value: 官网称其有普华永道和碧桂园集团15年工作经验，曾负责投资者关系及产业链投资，参与募集超30亿美元并完成地产产业链投资超50亿元；中国及香港注册会计师，主导投资贝壳、追觅科技和丰翼科技。

facts.label: 韦毅｜董事总经理履历
facts.value: 官网称其曾在毕马威伦敦和万达集团任职，毕业于华威大学及伦敦政治经济学院，具英国特许会计师资格，并有15年投资并购、管理咨询和创业经历；代表项目包括蜂巢能源、欣旺达动力、秦淮数据、众纳能源和墨睿科技。

facts.label: 杜浩｜董事总经理履历
facts.value: 官网称其曾任职微软、毕马威和招商资产管理，从业12年，拥有浙江大学工学学士、香港中文大学信息工程硕士及香港注册会计师资格；在CGVC主导投资蓝箭航天、紫光展锐、壁仞科技、合肥长鑫和盛合晶微等项目。

facts.label: 孙梁浩｜董事总经理履历
facts.value: 官网称其曾任职中植产业投资，有10年投资经验，毕业于伦敦政治经济学院地产经济学与金融硕士；关注生命科技、生物材料、互联网医疗、医疗服务和医疗器械，团队代表项目包括中科国生、创领心律、亚心医疗、医联健康、新瑞鹏和远也科技。

public_profile.summary: Hong Kong Investment Corporation Limited（HKIC，香港投资管理有限公司）是香港特区政府全资持有的耐心资本投资机构，采用“投资+”方式，兼顾中长期合理财务回报与香港经济和产业竞争力。官网披露初始部署资本为620亿港元，管理四个投资组合，并聚焦硬科技、生物科技、健康科技、新能源与绿色科技。

milestones.description: 特区政府财政司司长在2020-21年度预算案中宣布设立香港增长组合，支持具香港关联的策略性投资；该组合后来纳入HKIC管理。
政府在2022-23年度预算案宣布为香港增长组合增加100亿港元，其中50亿港元用于策略性创科基金、50亿港元用于大湾区投资基金。
HKIC成立；同年《施政报告》宣布设立300亿港元共同投资基金。
陈家齐出任HKIC首任行政总裁，委任期为三年。

track_record.description: 截至2025年10月底，HKIC官网披露已投资超过150个项目；这是该日期的机构统计口径。
截至2025年10月底的披露中，已有两家被投公司在香港上市，另有十多家当年已递交或计划递交香港上市申请；计划申请不等同已完成上市。
HKIC称截至2025年10月底，每投入1港元吸引超过6港元长期市场资本；该比例为机构所述资本撬动口径，不是基金回报率。
截至2024年底，HKIC称已投资资本不到初始资本规模的五分之一，并产生超过23亿港元投资收入；这是机构披露的阶段性累计口径，不代表年化基金收益率。
Investors included Shanghai State-owned Capital Investment and affiliated funds, Hong Kong Investment Corporation, Tencent, and returning shareholders.

What we look for Investment Criteria We're investing in Baltimore's best technology companies. Geography Located in Baltimore City or committed to headquartering in Baltimore City. Stage of Development Early revenue or have a product or service that can be evaluated for commercial readiness. Industry Focus High-growth technology companies (excluding bio-tech, medical device, and real estate). Business Plan High-growth, scalable, and capital efficient. Structure Typically convertible debt or preferred stock. Investment Duration Typically 5 years to exit or sale. Style Lead or value-added co-investor. public_profile.summary: 艾智远是趋境科技 CEO，具备清华计算机博士背景，研究和工程经验涉及分布式系统优化、并行计算与分布式存储。他曾在深信服担任多个大数据、数字化和 AI 应用部门的研发主管，之后创业推动 AI Infra 与大模型推理基础设施产品化。公开采访称趋境科技由清华计算机系教授与真知创投发起，核心创始团队出身于同一学术团队。

founderEvidence.quote: 两位首席科学家提供关键技术纵深。王鑫曾任百度量子计算研究所Tech Leader，主导研发工业级量子软件平台“量桨”，长期从事量子算法、量子信息与量子人工智能研究，在PRL、PRX Quantum、Nature Computational Science、IEEE TIT、NeurIPS、AAAI、ISCA、HPCA、MICRO 等顶刊和顶会发表论文百余篇，主持和参与量子算法与量超融合方向的国自然重大研究计划和国家重点研发计划。刘金国曾在全球中性原子量子计算领军团队——哈佛大学 Lukin 组从事博士后研究，并在其孵化的全球头部中性原子量子计算公司QuEra 任全职顾问，深度参与QuEra 团队组建与软件栈建设，系统积累了从理论、软件到硬件映射的复合经验。刘金国长期深耕中性原子体系模拟、量子算法和组合优化，是国内量子软件开源社区核心布道者之一，也是 Yao.jl 主要贡献者之一。

public_profile.summary: 刘金国是幻码跃迁联合创始人及首席科学家，长期研究中性原子量子计算、量子算法与组合优化。投资界对公司的融资报道介绍，他曾在哈佛大学 Lukin 研究组从事博士后研究，后任 QuEra 全职顾问并参与团队组建和软件栈建设，也是 Yao.jl 主要贡献者之一。详细学位、任职时间线未公开。

entityProfiles.name: Aaron Levie
entityProfiles.role: ceo box - 您的业务存在于内容之中。用AI释放它

affiliationEvidence.quote: Aaron Levie | @levie | ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI

viewpoints.title: AI领域真是疯狂的一天。前沿模型刚刚大幅降价，Opus 5.5价格下调，现在GPT-6 Sol和Luna又把token价格降低了50%。AI中每个任务成本（在同类对比基础上）下降的速度，是历史上任何其他技术都无法比拟的。而每当AI成本下降，你可以部署智能体来应对的用例就会急剧增加。这就是杰文斯悖论在智能体上的应用。这些改进将直接推动AI在经济中更广泛地扩散，因为我们可以用智能体来处理我们所有的数据、扫描代码中的安全问题、通读所有日志数据来做决策、在工作流中部署智能体集群，等等。token成本与这些用例能否大规模开放直接相关。

在Box，我们一直在使用Box Agent测试Opus 5.5处理各种涉及非结构化数据的复杂企业知识工作任务。总体而言，我们看到了前沿能力水平，与Opus 5相比性能有了重大提升。与Opus 5相比，使用的token减少了63%，冗长度降低了42%，速度提升了30%。而且模型本身也更便宜，因此对于企业将要进行的任何智能体计算机使用、编码、分析或数据工作来说，这都是一个重大胜利。以下是我们执行的各种行业测试中任务成功和性能提升的一些示例：• 金融服务——尽职调查（任务准确率+39%）：一年的交易记录，任务是找出收购目标定价工具中的每一处计算错误。Opus 5.5在每次尝试中都取得了满分结果，所用字数仅为Opus 5的一半，总体消耗的token减少了82%。• 技术——云成本分析（任务准确率+65%）：确定一家公司实际应当对其云支出做出哪些改变。Opus 5.5为留存计算选择了正确的基础，并全程保持了源数据单位约定的一致性，因此最终得出的数字确实站得住脚。它所用时间仅为Opus 5的一半，token减少了70%。• 消费品——客户账户分析（任务准确率+17%）：为某个客户账户设定引导目标，需要综合已签署合同、满意度追踪表和团队指标表。合同从未说明高级/初级人员比例，因此Opus 5.5从18人名单中推导出了这一比例，并展示了它所使用的规则；若干客户在个别调查问题上获得了满分10分，因此它对每位客户的回答进行了平均，而不是只选出单个10分。它用一半时间完成了这项任务，token减少了78%。• 临床诊断——数据分析（任务准确率+15%）：疟疾快速检测在旱季和雨季的表现：根据两份临床PDF构建患者记录，按季节和性别计算阳性检测率，并检验检测阳性患者与检测阴性患者之间的寄生虫计数是否确实存在差异。Opus 5.5发现两组的标准差相差超过100倍，于是以正确方式重新运行，并发现旱季差异终究并不成立。这一准确率提升的同时，最终答案长度仅为Opus 5的一半，而且端到端所需token也减少了78%。客户很快就能在Box AI Studio中使用Opus 5.5构建AI智能体。

代表你进行交易的个人代理的变现潜力相当可观。如果你想象代理完全有能力端到端地处理任意复杂的任务，那么最终必然会有大量商业活动通过它们进行。你会从把日常简单而烦人的任务丢给代理开始。然后随着人们逐渐习惯，他们就会开始把更复杂的任务交给代理，最终通过这些系统产生的支出甚至会比以前更多。如果你能降低商业和服务的摩擦，那么你最终会花得更多。因此，这为代理提供商（Muse等）创造了大量机会，同时也为构建代理希望交互的层（商业、本地、B2B服务等）带来了全新机会。对多个层面来说都是双赢。
简直无法被代理集群穿透 https://t.co/tg7SZ4d0xu

个人智能体是“打造智能体真正想要的东西”这一理念的终极体现。像 Muse 这样的产品形态，核心在于你能够把任务交给智能体，并确保它端到端地完整执行。要做到这一点，智能体必须能够顺利使用你的工具，或运用自身工具来完成任务。它要能使用你的 MCP 或 CLI，轻松浏览你的网站，具备交易能力，等等。如今你需要争夺的新注意力，不再来自用户本身，而是来自智能体。这意味着，那些能让智能体最顺畅地订餐、处理电商交易、预订航班、与本地经济互动，以及访问我们的数据和信息的工具，将会被最频繁地使用。这最终将成为自 App Store 以来消费科技领域最大的机遇与变革。

Jev 将极大地帮助代理在工作流程、数据分类、判断调用以及企业中数百种其他用例中做出瞬间决策。这里有一个与 Box 和 Jev 的快速演示，让这一点变得真实。该演示从 Box 中提取一份事件报告，询问它是否面向客户以及严重程度如何，将文件移动到升级、监控或审查文件夹中，并设置一个带有结果的元数据模板实例。这一切几乎瞬间发生，且成本几乎为零。你可以想象这在保险索赔、合同管理、贷款处理、安全审查、客户日志分析等方面的应用。这绝对是一类全新的 AI 用例。
令人无比兴奋的是，仍然存在着我们大多数人甚至未曾关注过的整个AI创新宇宙。能够以极快的速度、极低的成本处理信息，并具备高水平的能力，这对大量企业任务来说意义重大。数据分类任务、工作流内部的路由决策、面对特定领域问题时的决策制定、关于安全或安保的快速判断等等，都是大量流程中的关口。这种模型和方法在企业中的智能体工作流中可能会相当酷。

AI模型的力量与企业试图自动化的最终工作流程之间，存在着巨大的鸿沟。这一差距正是应用型AI层需要填补的机遇。你需要将智能连接到工作流程中，往往还要重新设计流程，聚合正确的上下文与数据，提供恰到好处的“人在回路”体验，推动变革管理，进行特定领域的评估，管理数据与流程的安全性和治理，等等。我们将看到这一层在每一个垂直和水平类别中涌现。而且颇具讽刺意味的是，即使模型以惊人的速度不断改进，这一层依然必须存在——甚至可能变得更加重要和有用。更强的能力使得更复杂的任务得以被攻克，但如果你在这一层做得不好，挑战也会被放大。与@sonyatweetybird聊AI扩散所涉及的所有事情，真的非常有趣。

好帖子。我并不完全同意其中的所有观点，但它确实反映了前沿AI总体前进道路上许多实际现实，无论我们喜不喜欢。在我们所看到的模型能力水平上，某种形式的行业协调自律将不可避免；这总体上是件好事。最大的问题在于大家能否就具体内容达成一致。然而，从目前的政治走向来看，实验室们甚至有可能根本没有发言权。而更大的问题还在于，是否所有国家都会参与。任何“放缓”都取决于广泛参与，而从博弈论的角度看，在风险变得更加严重和明显之前，这种情况不太可能发生。预计接下来一段时间会相当混乱。
这个非常酷。现在你可以将 Box 挂载到 agent 沙箱，让 agent 在其计算机上读写文件变得容易得多。当 AI agent 在企业中执行关键工作流时，它们将需要人们一直拥有的那些基础能力。https://t.co/h1BW92pMtH

更多来自路上的故事。本周与来自银行、媒体、信息服务、保险和咨询行业的几十位技术负责人会面，讨论企业中的智能体。当前一些最大的趋势： * 网络安全！所有人都对来自AI的漏洞增长速度感到紧张，以及OpenAI Hugging Face事件的影响。这个话题不像在硅谷那样具有存在主义色彩，但仍然高度关注，并且务实于如何在自身环境中操作性地应对。由于AI带来了大量新发现，仍然难以跟上他们现在必须执行的所有变化。 * 模型之争仍在继续。大多数公司正在其企业内部部署多个前沿模型。很难对任何东西进行标准化，并且看到不同团队和用例之间存在不同偏好。但资金仍然集中在少数几家供应商身上。在这些组织中，开放权重模型在大规模应用方面仍处于起步阶段，通常是因为缺乏本土的“前沿”开源选项。这里对更多选择有相当大的兴趣，但到目前为止可去之处很少。 * 智能体安全与身份。与Hugging Face事件有些关联，当智能体试图进入它们能进入的每一个系统时，人们对智能体安全和身份管理方面的新挑战有了更多认识。在理想世界中，企业可以为所有智能体设置身份并控制它们的行为，但当然有时智能体也需要完全以用户身份行事。 * 流程再造。大多数公司意识到，智能体的最大优势在于能够改变实际工作流程本身，从而充分获得AI带来的收益。当公司能够调整其工作流程以支持智能体改变工作方式，而不是仅仅将智能体叠加到现有流程上时，投资回报率要高得多。但大问题是，谁能够真正推动这些变革，这项工作应该放在哪里，等等。最好的经验仍然是在职能部门中嵌入FDE。 * 对架构进行果断调整。大多数公司都有仅在过去一两年内就多次更换不同供应商系统的例子。我可能从未像在当前环境中这样频繁听到“我们试过X，但不行，所以换成了Y”。这里的教训是，由于创新发生得太快，没有人会一直等到某个供应商把事情做对，他们只会转向下一个。 * 评估！大多数公司在对其工作流程的评估方面仍然处于非常早期的阶段。几十位客户中只有少数几位提到了这一点——当前企业有一个巨大机会，可以清楚了解他们的工作实际上是如何进行的，以及AI在这方面的表现如何。 * 遗留系统仍然是一个障碍。一如既往，遗留系统仍然是一个主要问题，阻碍企业快速采用AI。数据分散在并非为智能体世界构建的遗留环境中。公司花费大量时间仅仅是在清理这些旧平台。 还有更多话题，但这些往往是当前企业中最受关注的一些事项。
很高兴能与OpenAI更深入地合作，让你可以在ChatGPT中安全地处理Box里的企业内容。软件继续走向无头化，我们坚信未来的工作将是AI代理，它们能够在任何地方处理数据并执行工作流。https://t.co/CNZv5CH8bn
个人助理代理将成为一个非常令人兴奋的AI类别。这是首次出现对消费者有意义的高token量代理用例。目前正涌现出许多不同的方法，而且竞争将异常激烈，因为这些代理会随着时间的推移，媒介大量的消费者支出。但这无疑直接契合Meta的优势：需要大量算力，可以通过广告和商业变现，以软件为核心的体验因此能够大规模分发，等等。
这里有一个很好的提醒：随着人工智能进展迅速加速，你在构建时很可能应该怀有一个愿景，考虑到至少几个数量级的能力提升或可用的token量增长。目前最好的机会是那些你今天就能用勉强可行的技术为客户创造价值，但完整使命在当今技术下几乎不可能实现的方向。有很多产品需要比现在多几个数量级的数据处理能力（因此目前在经济上几乎不可行的想法），或者模型能力相对于所需水平仍处于起步阶段。最好是为这些场景进行构建。

到目前为止，AI就业预测的结果与许多人的想法正好相反。之所以出现这种情况，是因为AI正在把自动化带入那些需求特征并非有限的领域。AI让公司能够做到远超以往的事情，但智能体仍然需要人类操作员和监督才能从中产生价值。而且，AI不仅没有取代许多理论上最可能受AI影响的岗位——比如工程师或律师——反而还在整个经济中创造或壮大了整类整类的职业。网络安全、FDE、智能体操作员、非软件领域的工程师，以及大量职业类别都将迎来爆发式增长。目前尚不清楚这一趋势是否或何时会逆转，因为我们不断发现AI将打开的全新需求领域。
互联网几乎完全没有为这样一个未来做好准备：届时每个人的个人代理都在四处奔走，替他们执行任务。在基础设施层面、用户体验、新商业模式等方面，将涌现出无穷无尽的新挑战和新机遇。https://t.co/lmbQNJAeF6

GPT-6 Astra 已发布。我们一直在 Box 的企业复杂工作评估中对该模型进行早期预览测试。在我们扩展且难度最高的测试集上，它现在是我们测试过的最佳模型。总体而言，GPT-6 Astra 在编码、分析、逻辑以及处理复杂企业知识工作所需的领域特定知识方面，提供了突破性的能力水平。 在我们的评估中，我们在 Box Agent 中使用 GPT-6 Astra 模型，并为其分配了一组代表各行业真实工作场景的困难任务。这些任务通常需要人们花费数小时才能正确完成，并且需要深厚的领域专业知识。GPT-6 Astra 的总体得分为 77%，而 GPT-5.6 Sol 为 74%，代表了前沿性能。但更值得关注的是，在极其复杂的个别任务类型上，它取得了一些更大的进步。以下是测试中的几个示例，展示了这将在不同行业产生多大的影响： * 媒体与娱乐（48% → 100%，+52 分）。根据四个团队一年的制作数据，按盈利能力对电影类型和国家进行排名，其中的关键在于应用下一年的税收激励修正，同时避免重复计算。GPT-6 Astra 在每次尝试中都表现完美。Sol 的排名正确，但基础比率有误。 * 科技（69% → 97%，+28 分）。从一堆绩效和基础设施文档中选择优先资助哪个地区，而这些文档从未明确说明任务简报所要求的指标。GPT-6 Astra 指出了这一缺口，将自己得出的数字标注为代理指标，并发现了一项与底层数据不符的增长声明。GPT-5.6 Sol 则将代理指标报告为真实数据。 * 法律（69% → 93%，+24 分）。根据公司自身的合同政策审查一份保密协议，仅得出正确结论还不够；答案还必须引用其背后的条款。两个模型都拒绝批准该草案，但只有 GPT-6 Astra 区分了责任上限的结构是否被允许，与其金额是否具有可辩护性，并指出了能够解决该问题的政策语言。GPT-5.6 Sol 在没有引用条款的情况下论证了相同的结论，这在法律行业是一个严重错误。 * 医疗保健（53% → 77%，+23 分）。审核一批放射学报告中的错误，并对每项错误的严重程度进行评级。GPT-6 Astra 发现了一份膝关节影像报告中的术语错误，而 GPT-5.6 Sol 在两次尝试中均未发现，并且在严重程度分级方面比仅仅标记存在问题更为可靠。 * 能源（82% → 97%，+15 分）。根据一年的电表日志，为两个设施编制一份能耗报告，而实际上只有其中一个站点存在数据缺失。GPT-6 Astra 发现了这一点，并划出了一条大多数审核人员不会划出的界线：另一个站点异常的太阳能读数是一个需要调查的测量问题，而不是记录中的缺口。GPT-5.6 Sol 则将两个站点都报告为数据不完整。 Astra 显然将在驱动和编排企业工作流方面带来显著的提升。随着其持续推出，我们很快将在 Box AI Studio 中提供 GPT-6 Astra 作为客户构建智能体的一个选项。
开源AI的又一重大时刻。基础设施平台正在发挥作用。模型在不断进步。生态系统正获得深度投资。商业模式正在奏效。https://t.co/bcOVmTEryv
本周AI发布简直疯狂，现在Muse又带来了一项重大新模型更新。我们似乎在能力进步上达到了逃逸速度。如果这东西以开放权重发布，将彻底改变美国开放权重竞争力的格局。https://t.co/hOG17UMECG
AI用于网络安全的时代即将迎来爆发式增长。模型在发现和利用漏洞方面正变得越来越出色。前沿模型处于领先地位，但我们已经看到开放权重模型也紧随其后。大多数企业已经被网络安全发现所淹没，而现在这种情况只会成倍增加。利用更多AI——再加上人工监督——进行分诊和自动化修复，基本上是唯一的前进之路。如果你想知道AI会创造哪些工作岗位，那毫无疑问，从事安全领域将迎来大好时机。

既然基础开放权重AI模型正在变得好得多，而后训练基础设施也日趋成熟和商业化，对于那些拥有大量数据的公司来说，将会出现全新的玩法，让他们能够拥有自己的模型。过去，如果你拥有庞大的信息语料库，授权数据用于外部模型训练是唯一的选择，但现在你完全可以合理地去训练自己的模型，而不必承担与研究实验室竞争的成本和复杂性。通用前沿模型在广泛领域仍将占据优势，因为它们能够处理最广泛的任务集，但你绝对可以预见一个未来：在各个垂直领域和行业中，模型数量将远比今天多得多。
随着AI安全事件频发，拥有最先进的AI代理来检测和预防安全问题将变得至关重要。前沿模型在网络领域显然仍处于领先地位，但开源模型正在迅速追赶。风云变幻的时代。https://t.co/F0eEZLe6tt

本周的科技财报电话会议是一个重要提醒，说明软件与人工智能之间的关系有多么宝贵。软件为数据管理方式、工作流中业务逻辑的维护、信息访问的管理与治理、数据保护等提供了护栏。你希望这些系统每次都以相同方式运行，万无一失。而智能体则在这些系统内部、利用这些数据来执行任务，就像人类原本会做的那样。但其规模远超人类以往所能达到的水平，这正是确定性控制比以往任何时候都更重要的原因。事实上，部署智能体的许多最佳方式将直接嵌入软件系统本身，例如来自Salesforce、Box、Harvey、ServiceNow等平台。这些平台可以针对其工作流和领域优化智能体，利用其垂直领域独有的评估与上下文，并无头连接其他智能体。最终结果是软件和人工智能的采用率携手提升。软件与智能体将协同工作，并随着时间推移大幅扩大IT总可寻址市场的规模。

企业内不同工作流程对持续、不间断计算机工作的契合度各异，这是导致智能体扩散速度不均的原因之一。智能编码之所以呈现爆发式增长，关键在于这类工作的经济价值与纯数字信息产出直接挂钩，且单次任务量理论上可无限扩展。这意味着随着AI智能体单次处理能力提升，以及模型在该任务类型上的能力增强，它们几乎能即时部署到更大规模的工作负载中。但当前多数工作流程的设计并不天然具备这种特性。销售代表需要与客户建立反馈循环才能推进特定客户的工作，律师需要与委托人沟通，医生需要与患者互动。因此，大规模的智能体工作至少在默认形态上，很可能不会与编码领域雷同。相反，在许多这类领域中，智能体需要融入为AI重新设计的工作流程。Factory公司的马坦·格林伯格在《训练数据》播客中提出了精辟见解：如果明天所有人都请病假，令牌使用量将骤降，因为无人发出指令。这揭示了当前智能体在后台自主运行的程度之低，而未来这恰恰应成为智能体工作的主流形态。在法律领域，它将处理每份流入的合同；在销售领域，智能体将遍历客户记录，识别最佳外联时机；在生命科学研究中，将是智能体集群研读每项测试或全部研究成果。要实现这些，业务流程必须重构以支持智能体，而非延续当前大量依赖人工的模式。这正是当下的重大机遇，但其扩散方式将与智能编码截然不同——涉及大量变革管理、数据清理、流程再造等工作。

无论您是在企业内推动AI应用，还是为企业打造AI解决方案，这篇帖子都极具价值。AI带来的生产力提升幅度将大相径庭——远超您的想象——因为如果您从根本上改变工作流程以支持智能代理，在前沿领域所能实现的成果将极为显著。挑战在于，大多数人不会或无法自然而然地做到这一点，因为这涉及到的复杂性太高。因此，大量基于智能代理的自动化将来自于将代理无缝接入工作流程，而用户最终甚至不会察觉或在意：“对于其他人来说，工作必须在不改变他们工作方式的前提下完成，这意味着AI要退居幕后。为什么AI非得由人来提示呢？只需找出最重复的流程，在员工已习惯的现有记录系统中构建代理即可。” 对于当下大多数希望从AI中获得显著收益的企业来说，这才是真正需要着手的工作。少一些“百花齐放”的思路，多一些“找出企业中10个杠杆效应最高的环节，并对其应用自动化”的做法。这里没有真正的捷径可走。
